**Company Overview**
 Stellantis is a leading global automaker and mobility provider that offers clean, connected, affordable, and safe mobility solutions. Our Company’s strength lies in the breadth of our iconic brand portfolio, the diversity and passion of our people, and our deep roots in the communities in which we operate. Our ambitious electrification and software strategies and the creation of an innovative ecosystem of strategic, game\-changing partnerships are driving our transformation to a sustainable mobility tech company.
   

  

 The driving force behind us is the diverse and talented group of employees around the world who bring their passion and experience to their work every day. And while we are a truly global organization, we remain deeply rooted in the communities in which we operate and where our colleagues live and work.
   

  

 With industrial operations in nearly 30 countries, Stellantis could consistently exceed the evolving needs and expectations of consumers in more than 130 markets, while creating superior value for all stakeholders.
   

  

**Job Overview**
**Job Title: AI/ML Engineer – Automotive Data, DevOps \& Developer Productivity**
 We are looking for an
 **AI/ML Engineer** 
 with around
 **4 years of experience** 
 , preferably in the
 **automotive domain** 
 , to support the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of AI/ML solutions for connected, embedded, or vehicle\-related applications. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in
 **machine learning** 
 ,
 **data pipelines** 
 , and
 **DevOps/MLOps practices** 
 , along with exposure to
 **AI\-driven developer productivity tools and methods** 
 to improve engineering efficiency, code quality, and automation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and optimize AI/ML models for automotive use cases such as driver monitoring, predictive analytics, perception, diagnostics, or connected vehicle applications.
* Build and maintain data pipelines for data collection, preprocessing, transformation, validation, and feature engineering from structured and unstructured sources.
* Work on end\-to\-end model lifecycle activities including training, evaluation, deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.
* Collaborate with software, data, validation, and platform teams to integrate AI/ML components into production systems.
* Support deployment of AI/ML workloads using DevOps/MLOps practices, including CI/CD, containerization, automated testing, and infrastructure management.
* Develop and maintain scripts, APIs, and services for scalable model serving and batch/stream processing.
* Contribute to developer productivity initiatives by leveraging AI tools for code review, code generation, documentation, test\-case generation, defect analysis, and workflow automation.
* Evaluate and integrate AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software development speed, code quality, and release efficiency.
* Ensure data quality, reproducibility, and traceability across datasets, code, and model artifacts.
* Participate in troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of deployed AI/ML solutions.
* Contribute to technical documentation, code reviews, and process standardization.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Around 4 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, preferably in the automotive domain.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Good understanding of machine learning and deep learning concepts, including model training, validation, and inference workflows.
* Hands\-on experience in building and maintaining data pipelines using tools/frameworks such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, or similar.
* Exposure to DevOps/MLOps practices, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and cloud/on\-prem deployment workflows.
* Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, model evaluation, and debugging.
* Familiarity with APIs, microservices, and deployment of AI/ML solutions into production environments.
* Good understanding of software engineering best practices, version control, testing, and documentation.


**Competencies Required**
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work across AI/ML, data engineering, and DevOps domains.
* Good collaboration skills to work with cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Strong ownership and ability to independently drive technical tasks.
* Structured communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and engineering methods.


**Additional Competencies for Improving Developer Productivity Using AI Tools and Methods**
* Understanding of AI\-assisted software development workflows.
* Experience or exposure to tools for:
+ AI\-based code review
+ code generation / code completion
+ unit test generation
+ documentation generation
+ bug triaging and defect analysis
+ PR review automation

* Ability to identify engineering bottlenecks and propose AI\-driven productivity improvements.
* Knowledge of integrating AI tools into CI/CD or developer workflows such as GitHub, GitLab, TeamCity, Jenkins, or similar ecosystems.
* Familiarity with using LLM\-based tools for:
+ improving code quality
+ reducing manual effort
+ accelerating debugging
+ improving developer feedback loops

* Awareness of limitations of AI tools, including:
+ hallucination risk
+ context limitations
+ code privacy and security concerns
+ validation requirements before production use

* Ability to define metrics for developer productivity improvement, such as:
+ reduced PR review time
+ improved unit test coverage
+ faster root\-cause analysis
+ reduced manual documentation effort
+ improved code quality consistency


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in automotive domains such as ADAS, autonomous driving, driver monitoring, cockpit AI, vehicle diagnostics, or connected vehicle systems.
* Exposure to frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, or OpenCV.
* Knowledge of MLOps tools like MLflow, Databricks, or model registry solutions.
* Understanding of embedded or edge AI deployment is an added advantage.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience working in Agile teams and cross\-functional product environments.
* Exposure to developer productivity tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Codeium, Cursor, AI PR reviewers, or similar platforms.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Automotive Engineering, or related field.


 At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future.

description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid Technical Lead role focuses on architecting and guiding enterprise data governance and catalog solutions using Informatica cloud and metadata platforms. The role drives robust data lineage standardized metadata and governed data marketplaces to improve data quality compliance and business insight with particular benefit to property and casualty insurance operations and decision making while mentoring technical teams across day shifts in a stable no travel environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end to end design and implementation of cloud based data governance solutions that leverage Informatica Axon and enterprise data catalog capabilities to establish trusted data assets for business stakeholders across the organization.
* Oversee configuration and optimization of Infa Cloud Data Governance and Catalog to create comprehensive data dictionaries lineage views and ownership models that improve transparency and reduce risk in data driven decision making.
* Guide setup and administration of Infa Cloud Metadata Command Center to ensure accurate metadata harvesting standardized metadata policies and consistent monitoring of data quality metrics across diverse source and target systems.
* Drive creation and enhancement of Infa Cloud Data Marketplace assets to enable curated and governed data sharing supporting self service analytics while enforcing compliance and appropriate usage controls.
* Coordinate integration between Informatica Axon Data Govern and Informatica EDC to deliver a unified governance experience that links business terms technical metadata and data quality rules for holistic oversight.
* Provide technical leadership to project teams by defining implementation patterns reviewing solution designs and resolving complex issues related to data ingestion profiling and cataloging workflows.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects data stewards and product teams to translate governance objectives into actionable technical configurations that align with corporate standards and regulatory expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing usage patterns of catalogs and marketplaces identifying adoption barriers and implementing enhancements that simplify discovery and responsible use of data assets.
* Coordinate hybrid work model practices by ensuring clear documentation standardized processes and effective communication channels so that on site and remote team members can deliver consistent outcomes during day shifts.
* Direct creation of operational runbooks and support procedures for Informatica cloud governance platforms to enable smooth handover to support teams and reduction of incident resolution time.
* Promote property and casualty insurance domain understanding by collaborating with business partners to capture product policy claims and underwriting data requirements and reflect them accurately in governed data assets.
* Monitor key performance indicators for governance implementations such as data quality scores catalog coverage and time to data discovery to demonstrate tangible value to business and support strategic decisions.
* Ensure alignment of governance solutions with organizational purpose by enabling responsible data use that supports fair pricing efficient claims handling and improved customer experiences in society.


**Qualifications**
* Possess eight to twelve years of progressive experience in data engineering or data management roles with at least several years focused on technical leadership of complex enterprise data initiatives.
* Demonstrate advanced expertise in Infa Cloud Data Governance and Catalog including hands on experience configuring domains attributes workflows and governance policies for large scale environments.
* Show strong proficiency using Infa Cloud Metadata Command Center to orchestrate metadata extraction manage connectors schedule scans and maintain high quality metadata repositories.
* Exhibit practical experience implementing and managing Infa Cloud Data Marketplace solutions that enable curated data products entitlement workflows and usage monitoring for business consumers.
* Deliver proven hands on capability with Informatica Axon Data Govern and Informatica EDC including setting up glossaries systems data sets lineage and data quality rules that connect business and technical perspectives.
* Apply solid understanding of property and casualty insurance concepts such as policies coverages claims processes and underwriting criteria to shape relevant data governance models when domain experience is available.
* Command strong skills in SQL and general data integration concepts to collaborate effectively with data engineering teams and ensure governed data aligns with upstream ingestion and transformation pipelines.
* Demonstrate experience working in hybrid delivery models and day shift schedules with the ability to manage distributed teams coordinate meetings and maintain productivity without travel requirements.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non technical stakeholders producing concise documentation presenting governance outcomes and driving alignment around data ownership and stewardship responsibilities.

**About 4flow**
 4flow is a global leader in logistics optimization, with a team of over 1,500 professionals across more than 20 locations worldwide. Our unique business model integrates supply chain consulting, advanced logistics software, 4PL services, and cutting\-edge logistics research to deliver innovative and end\-to\-end solutions.
   

  

 Our Bangalore office, located in Manyata Tech Park, is one of our newest and most dynamic hubs. Here, we are building a next\-generation, AI\-driven supply chain product from the ground up. Operating in a hybrid work model, this location offers a unique opportunity to join the development team at an early stage and play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology landscape.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with 6\+ years of experience to build scalable and intuitive frontend applications for our Business Insights platform within the 4PL ecosystem.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Vue.js, frontend engineering best practices, and modern UI/UX principles, along with experience building analytics dashboards and enterprise business applications. This role involves close collaboration with product, backend, AI, and data engineering teams to deliver high\-quality user experiences for analytics and AI\-powered insights.
   

  

**What your new challenge will look like**
* 6\+ years of frontend development experience with strong expertise in Vue.js and enterprise web application development.
* Design and develop scalable frontend applications using Vue.js (preferably Vue 3\), JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend tools.
* Build reusable, maintainable UI components and frontend modules.
* Develop responsive, high\-performance interfaces for analytics dashboards, KPI monitoring, operational insights, and AI\-powered business applications.
* Collaborate with product and UX teams to create intuitive, user\-friendly experiences.
* Translate business requirements and workflows into engaging frontend solutions.
* Contribute to design systems, reusable component libraries, and maintain consistency in styling, responsiveness, and accessibility.
* Build interactive dashboards and analytical interfaces using modern visualization libraries.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, analytics platforms, and real\-time data services.
* Optimize UI responsiveness, rendering performance, and API interactions for large datasets.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and responsive behavior across devices.
* Follow best practices for code quality, testing, maintainability, and secure frontend development.
* Work closely with product managers, backend engineers, data engineers, AI/ML teams, and UX designers.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, and code reviews.
* Strong proficiency in Vue.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Experience with Pinia/Vuex, REST APIs, WebSocket integrations, and build tools such as Vite or Webpack.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, accessibility standards, and user\-centered design.
* Experience working with design systems, wireframes, mockups, and reusable component libraries.
* Ability to transform complex analytical workflows into clean, intuitive user interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience with visualization libraries such as ECharts, Chart.js, and D3\.js.
* Experience building analytics dashboards, SaaS products, or enterprise business applications.
* Strong knowledge of Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, frontend testing, and performance optimization.
* Nice to have experience with AI\-assisted/conversational interfaces, micro\-frontends, cloud\-native deployments, logistics or supply chain platforms, and ClickHouse\-based analytics applications.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Success measured by delivering scalable and responsive applications, improving usability and adoption, creating reusable frontend components, and enabling seamless integration with analytics and AI systems.


**Why you belong at 4flow**
* Opportunity to build next\-generation AI\-powered business intelligence products.
* Work with modern frontend technologies and scalable architectures.
* Collaborative engineering culture with strong ownership.
* Exposure to analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale platforms.


**What we offer**
* A stable role within a company rooted in strong German roots, backed by a clear vision and long\-term security.
* A dynamic, international work environment with excellent opportunities for rapid career growth.
* Extensive professional development support, including a dedicated training budget and access to internal learning programs.
* A permanent position with a competitive base salary, attractive bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits package.
* Hybrid work model
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well\-being.
* Regular sports activities, team events, and company getaways that foster connection and collaboration.
* Complimentary lunch, beverages, and coffee at all 4flow locations.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage, including GMC, GPA, GTL, and OPD.

description:
**Who Is Sa.global**
 sa.global, a global Microsoft partner, specializes in delivering AI\-powered, cloud\-based solutions tailored for service\-centric organizations such as architecture and engineering, legal, consulting, software services, accounting, and homebuilding. We help over 800,000 Microsoft Dynamics users across 80 countries to deliver operational excellence and financial performance for their organizations. An 11\-time winner of the coveted Microsoft Dynamics Partner of the Year Award, sa.global is also a part of Microsoft’s elite Inner Circle. Established in 1990, we are now a 1000\+ member strong global organization with a presence in 25 countries.
   

  

 For more information about sa.global, please click www.saglobal.com.
   

  

**Why choose sa.global**
 Open, flexible, vibrant, collaborative, and diverse – these are just some of the terms that our employees use to describe the culture at sa.global. We believe and encourage innovative and dynamic thinking. Our culture and values give us the extra edge to help us scale greater heights.
   

  

**Led by our Core Values:** 
 Agile, Capable, and Committed, which form an integral part of who we are, we constantly strive to provide an inclusive work environment. Our employees come from varied cultural and social backgrounds, and we strive each day to work towards making sa.global a great place to work.
   

  

**Values of sa.global**
* Contribute towards a working environment that represents “one sa.global” where everyone is seen as an equal, and equality and diversity is championed.
* Interact with a wide variety of colleagues, customers, and stakeholders at all levels with respect, courtesy, and professionalism.
* Come as you are, make work fun \& others successful, and foster an always learning mentality.


**Purpose Statement**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior React Developer to independently design, build, maintain, and enhance modern, scalable, and user\-friendly software applications.
   

  

 As the primary developer responsible for the application, this role requires a high degree of technical ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to manage development priorities with limited oversight. The ideal candidate combines strong React and front\-end development expertise with the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable technical solutions.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Senior React Developer will have end\-to\-end responsibility for the development and ongoing support of the organization’s React\-based software application.
   

  

 The role will contribute across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently, making technical recommendations, identifying risks, and collaborating directly with business stakeholders, product owners, vendors, and other technical resources as needed.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications using React.
* Serve as the primary technical owner of the React application and related front\-end components.
* Translate business requirements, user needs, wireframes, and functional specifications into working software.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible, and maintainable user\-interface components.
* Manage application architecture, code quality, technical standards, and development practices.
* Integrate front\-end applications with APIs, databases, services, and third\-party platforms.
* Write clean, efficient, secure, and well\-documented code.
* Independently troubleshoot and resolve application defects, performance issues, and production incidents.
* Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and front\-end tests.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, security, accessibility, and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Assess technical requirements, provide development estimates, and identify risks or dependencies.
* Manage source control, branching, code releases, and deployment activities.
* Maintain technical documentation relating to application architecture, functionality, configurations, integrations, and support processes.
* Monitor application health and address issues following releases or system changes.
* Coordinate with external vendors or technical specialists when additional expertise is required.
* Communicate technical issues, recommendations, and trade\-offs clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve application quality, stability, and development efficiency.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Five or more years of software development experience, including significant hands\-on experience with React.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Advanced knowledge of React, including components, hooks, state management, routing, and application architecture.
* Experience independently owning or supporting a business\-critical software application.
* Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and modern front\-end development standards.
* Experience integrating applications with RESTful APIs or other web services.
* Strong understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and coding best practices.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and front\-end testing methodologies.
* Proficiency with Git, source control, branching strategies, and release management.
* Experience working across the full software development lifecycle.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requirements, and manage deadlines.
* Ability to gather requirements and communicate directly with business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering stable, secure, and high\-quality software.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Next.js or another React\-based framework.
* Experience with state\-management tools such as Redux, Zustand, or React Context.
* Familiarity with Node.js and back\-end development.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps tools, and automated deployment processes.
* Knowledge of web accessibility standards and secure development practices.
* Experience working with component libraries or design systems.
* Familiarity with containerization, microservices, or distributed application environments.
* Experience managing third\-party integrations and external development vendors.
* Experience developing enterprise, SaaS, or business\-critical applications.


**Key Competencies**
* Independent technical ownership
* Problem\-solving and sound judgment
* Accountability and reliability
* Planning and prioritization
* Clear stakeholder communication
* Quality and attention to detail
* Adaptability and learning agility
* Risk identification and management
* User\-focused thinking
* Continuous improvement


**Contact Us!**
 If this is a promising opportunity for you and you possess the desired skills and experience, please apply for the role. We will be in touch!

**React Lead Developer** 




**Location: Pune** 




**Experience: 13 \-20 Years** 




  





 Apply here: React Developer – Fill out form
 



 Share you profile to Sabrish.a@capco.com
 



  





 As a React Developer, you’ll build and maintain the user\-facing components of web applications, delivering interactive, accessible, and visually engaging experiences. You’ll adhere to agreed frontend architecture and system design, partnering closely with the Lead React Developer to ensure reliable performance across devices and browsers, while meeting high standards for usability, accessibility, and maintainability.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





 \- Build and maintain React user interfaces using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, following established patterns and team standards.
 



 \- Implement assigned parts of key user journeys, focusing on correctness, performance basics, accessibility, and clean, readable code.
 



 \- Use and contribute to existing component libraries by adding small enhancements, fixing bugs, and following design system guidelines.
 



 \- Debug and resolve straightforward issues in existing codebases (UI defects, layout problems, minor functional bugs) with support from senior engineers.
 



 \- Ensure responsive behaviour across common screen sizes and verify changes in agreed target browsers/devices.
 



 \- Apply accessibility fundamentals (semantic HTML, labels, focus states, keyboard navigation) and use ARIA only when needed and guided by standards.
 



 \- Collaborate with product, UX/UI, backend engineers, and QA to clarify requirements, raise risks early, and deliver features end\-to\-end.
 



 \- Write and maintain unit/component tests for new work, and follow CI/CD pipelines (fixing build failures, addressing linting/type errors).
 



 \- Participate in code reviews by responding to feedback, learning team conventions, and gradually contributing constructive review comments.
 



 \- Document changes (README updates, component usage notes) and contribute to team ways of working through continuous improvement suggestions.
 



**Skills \& Experience** 



* 8 to 10 yrs of hands\-on experience building web applications or features using React and modern frontend tooling
* Good working knowledge of JavaScript (ES6\+) and basic familiarity with TypeScript (able to read and write typed components with guidance).
* Solid fundamentals in HTML5 and CSS3, including responsive layouts and common modern CSS patterns (Flexbox/Grid), plus basic understanding of browser APIs.
* Ability to debug and improve existing code with support (fixing UI/layout issues, addressing simple defects, making small functional enhancements).
* Understanding of core frontend concepts such as component structure, props/state, and introductory state management patterns (Context, basic Redux usage is a plus).
* Awareness of performance basics (avoiding unnecessary re\-renders, sensible component composition) and willingness to learn deeper optimisation techniques.
* Familiarity with accessibility fundamentals and inclusive UI practices (semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, basic ARIA; exposure to WCAG is a plus).
* Exposure to testing and code quality practices (for example: Jest/React Testing Library basics; willingness to learn integration/e2e testing).
* Clear communication skills, openness to feedback, and ability to collaborate with designers, engineers, and product partners in a team environment.

description:
**Description**
 Prime Video is disrupting traditional media with an ever\-increasing selection of movies, TV shows, Emmy Award winning original content, add\-on subscriptions including HBO and Showtime, and live events like Thursday Night Football. Within this expanding ecosystem, Linear TV (24/7 Television or broadcast programming) has emerged as one of our fastest\-growing segments, with viewership hours increasing significantly year over year. This growth demonstrates that even in the streaming era, customers deeply value the lean\-back, curated experience that Linear TV provides.
   

  

 Our data shows that Linear TV viewers develop strong habitual viewing patterns, spending more time on the platform and engaging more consistently than traditional VOD\-only users. The key to supporting these viewing habits is providing seamless, personalized discovery experiences through robust and scalable services. The Linear Discovery Service (LDS) team owns the critical infrastructure that determines how Live TV content is presented to customers \- from the composition of the homepage experience to search capabilities that help customers find live programming. We decide what content collections and carousels appear on Linear pages, their ordering, and how search results are ranked and displayed across all Prime Video clients, ensuring millions of customers can easily find and enjoy their favorite live programming.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to take an active role in shaping how customers discover and interact with Live TV on Prime Video. We need your passion, innovative ideas, and creativity to help continue to deliver on our ambitious goals of creating intuitive, personalized, and responsive discovery experiences at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer on the Linear Discovery Service team, you will:
   

  

* Design and implement the page composition engine that determines what carousels and content collections appear on Linear pages
* Build intelligent ordering systems that optimize the placement of content sections based on customer behavior and business rules
* Develop and maintain search services specifically optimized for Linear content, including live programs, channels, and upcoming shows
* Build and maintain scalable services that integrate with recommendation systems to provide personalized content listings
* Develop robust caching and content delivery mechanisms to ensure low\-latency responses for millions of concurrent users
* Collaborate with client teams to evolve page composition and search APIs based on new feature requirements
* Work with the Linear Personalization team to integrate recommendations into page composition and search ranking
* Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team's technical growth


 A day in the life
   

  

 You'll work on services that directly shape how millions of customers discover and engage with Live TV content. Your day might involve analyzing the performance of a new carousel ordering algorithm, optimizing search relevance for an upcoming major linear event or designing a solution for real\-time program updates. You'll balance performance, scalability, and maintainability while ensuring our services meet the high standards our customers expect.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Linear Discovery Service team owns the end\-to\-end discovery experience for Live TV content across Prime Video. We determine what customers see when they land on Linear pages through our page composition engine, how they search for live content, and how content is presented to them. We work closely with Linear client teams and the Linear Personalization team to deliver personalized, responsive, and intuitive browsing experiences. Our services handle millions of requests per day, providing real\-time content information, search results, and page composition decisions to customers worldwide.
   

  

 Our mission is to make Live TV content discovery on Prime Video seamless and engaging, helping customers easily find the content they love while discovering new programs that match their interests. We're focused on building intelligent, scalable services that can grow with our rapidly expanding Linear TV audience while maintaining the high performance our customers expect.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. **What this job involves:**
 Specific Duties:
   

  

**Operations:**
* Manage the team providing first line soft services to the Managed Facility, including Front Desk, Event, Cafeteria, Meeting Rooms, help desk, Space, Stationery, Reprographics, Waste, housekeeping services, consumables \& tools, pantry services, mailroom services.
* Assist the Facility Manager in developing and implementing strategic plans, policies, and procedures for the soft services department to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Oversee and coordinate the execution of janitorial services, including cleaning schedules, inventory control, and contractor management, to maintain a high standard of cleanliness and hygiene throughout the facility.
* Support the management and coordination of landscaping and grounds maintenance activities to ensure a well\-maintained and aesthetically pleasing exterior environment.
* Work closely with vendors and contractors to monitor the delivery of pest control, waste management, and other soft service\-related services, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and service level agreements.
* Conduct regular inspections of the facility to identify maintenance needs, safety hazards, and code violations, and liaise with appropriate teams to resolve issues promptly.
* Collaborate with the Facility Manager to manage budgets, control costs, and seek cost\-saving opportunities without compromising service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, including occupants and other facility management teams, to understand their needs and ensure timely and satisfactory resolution of service\-related concerns.
* Stay updated with industry trends and best practices to identify opportunities for improving soft service operations and implementing innovative solutions.
* Support the development and implementation of training programs for soft services staff to enhance their skills and knowledge.
* Provide administrative support to the Facility Manager, including preparing reports, maintaining records, and handling correspondence related to soft services.
* Responsibility for all Ad\-hoc duties and tasks as assigned by Manager.


**Waste Management:**
* Bins must be emptied, cleaned, and dried inside and out, bin\-liners replaced where necessary and placed in their original locations. Liners must be always used.
* Service Provider shall Collect the garbage from the garbage collection point and segregate the waste in recyclable and non\-recyclable type and shall ensure proper disposal of waste outside the premises as per the standards and directions provided by Authorities/LL
* Service Provider shall be responsible for arranging the transport and in consultation with Authority, shall identify the area / frequency for garbage disposal. Proper waste disposal system shall be adopted, and collection points shall be defined.
* Waste management methodology shall comply with the guidelines laid down in applicable Waste Management SOP.


**Safety Management:**
* Records are to be maintained on all employees training, including but not limited to hazard assessment and communications, permits and licenses and accident investigations.
* Implement permit\-to\-work programs where such work is required to be carried out but not limited to hot work, entry into confined space, work on fire suppression systems and work on high voltage and live electrical equipment’s.
* MSDS display and training on regular basis.
* PPE's to be always available for FM staff, team to ensure all international safety standards are adhered to.


**Staff Welfare:**
* Ensure all the staff members (in\-house \+ outsourced) are duly paid salary on time.
* All labour related statutes are compiled within timelines.
* Reward \& recognition activity is conducted regularly.
* Required site related training not limited to code of conduct, security, safety, POSH, skill up gradation and best practices to be conducted regularly.


**Reports \& Documents Management**
* Transition Manual, Daily Management reports, PPM Calendar, FM Service Provider/Supplier evaluation sheet, service reports, Incident/Accident register, M/C Cards, AMC Tracker, Asset Register, Consumption reports, Attendance Register, Audit report / Action Plan tracker, Complaint Management report, MMR \& QBR, Equipment checklists \& logbooks; Daily Cleaning Schedules, MSDS list, SOP's etc. Courier incoming/outgoing register; DSR, MMR etc. Training Records, Incident/accident register \& MSDS register.

**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** 

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.  This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 


**The Product** 

 Okta's Auth0 is an easy\-to\-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier\-0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.
 


**The Team** 

 The Enterprise Management team provides enterprise\-ready, centralized governance of the Auth0 resources our customers build on tenants, teams, and dashboard users under a single pane of glass. As customer environments grow in scale and complexity, we ensure secure, autonomous, and frictionless access through tenant\-level transparency and access controls that meet or exceed their security policies.
 



 We own the full lifecycle of tenants and teams, the management dashboards, and the public APIs that enable enterprise customers to programmatically govern their Auth0 environments at scale. Our work spans RBAC, self\-service SSO, and the tooling that enables internal teams to support customers on their Auth0 journey.
 



 We work with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and React to build highly available and performant services. We ship with quality our recent launches have gone live with zero production bugs.
 


**What you'll be doing:** 
* Design and build high\-performance, customer\-facing features end\-to\-end using React and Node.js/TypeScript, delivering from concept through production deployment.
* Architect and optimize backend APIs both public and internal for throughput, latency, and reliability at enterprise scale.

description:
Design, build, and support SAP ABAP and Fiori enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and applications aligned to business requirements. Role Overview A technical role delivered under a strict clean-core mandate. The program has deliberately constrained its build: 79% of requirements are met by standard configuration, and the WRICEF objects will be gated behind conditions precedent - a validated requirement, a quantified benefit, and confirmation that no standard alternative exists - and extensions are delivered on SAP BTP rather than by modifying the core. This role needs judgment as well as skill: the largest technical risk on the program is over-customization, specifically rebuilding a legacy shop-floor system''s bespoke lot-numbering and lot-handling logic one-for-one inside SAP. You will be expected to resist that. Key Responsibilities Translate functional specifications from all workstreams into technical designs, honest estimates and clean-core-compliant build approaches; challenge designs better solved by configuration.Develop the report backlog using CDS views, RAP services and analytical Fiori applications in preference to classical ABAP list reports.Develop enhancements using released extension points - BAdIs, key-user and developer extensibility - rather than core modifications or implicit enhancements.Design and build interfaces between S/4HANA, SAP Digital Manufacturing, factory-automation and edge systems and the analytics layer, using SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Event Mesh) plus IDoc, OData, REST and file patterns.Build custom and extended Fiori applications with SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements, including shop-floor UIs usable on hand-held devices and gloved hands, with Japanese and English language support.Build the traveler / batch-card print program and forms carrying resolved machine, tool, hardness, mold, cavity and lot detail; implement quality, hold and disposition approval workflows; build the flexible master-data maintenance application if it clears its gate.Build the composite KPI CDS layer and the post-Material-Ledger allocation engine in the agreed architecture; enforce clean-core governance - extension registry, released-API discipline, upgrade-safety review, code review - and document objects so client IT can maintain them. BATCH MANAGEMENT TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE - REQUIRED Hands-on Batch Management and end-to-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Batch and classification data structures in S/4HANA - batch master, characteristics and classification, batch determination and status - and how to read, extend and report on them without breaking standard behavior.Batch number assignment: standard internal/external number ranges, the batch number BAdI, and the judgment to say honestly when a bespoke lot-number format genuinely cannot be met by standard next-number maintenance. Replicating legacy lot-numbering one-for-one is this program''s largest over-customization risk.Batch characteristic copying and re-derivation on split and merge, including enhancement programs that update collected data each time a shop-floor control number is split.Cavity-level and sub-lot data: carrying mold, machine and cavity identity onto batch characteristics and onto planned/production orders via custom fields, and surfacing it on travelers, labels and packing documents.Traceability reporting: building forward/backward genealogy queries over batch data with CDS, integrating with the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability rather than rebuilding them.Interfaces that carry batch identity - SFC-to-batch one-to-one mapping with the digital manufacturing layer, vendor batch capture, batch data on delivery documents - and the handling of long (up to 40-digit) lot numbers through splits, an open design decision on this program. Required Qualifications 6+ years SAP technical development with 3+ full-lifecycle implementations, including at least 1 on S/4HANA.Strong ABAP OO and ABAP on HANA: CDS views, AMDP, code pushdown and performance optimization; hands-on RAP and modern extensibility (key-user and developer extensibility, released APIs, BAdIs).Demonstrable clean-core delivery: extensions that survive upgrades, and the discipline to refuse core modifications.SAPUI5 / Fiori development including Fiori Elements, annotations, custom controls and launchpad configuration.Hands-on SAP BTP including Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management) and event-based integration; Cloud Foundry or Kyma application development is an advantage.SAP integration technologies: OData, REST, SOAP, IDoc, ALE/EDI, the Data Replication Framework and file-based interfaces; forms and print output (Adobe Forms or SmartForms) for travelers, labels and packing documents.Development against PP, QM and MM/IM/WM with a working functional understanding of what those modules do. Preferred Qualifications Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan, including multi-language UI and print output.Integrating SAP Digital Manufacturing or an MES with S/4HANA, and machine/edge connectivity patterns (OPC UA; bridging non-standard protocols such as CC-Link via middleware or an edge gateway is a distinct advantage).Analytical CDS models consumed by SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud.SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management.ABAP Test Cockpit, abapGit, gCTS and CI/CD for SAP.SAP certification in ABAP for S/4HANA, Fiori application development, or BTP Integration Suite. Language Requirement - Bilingual English/Japanese Preferred, Not Required Fluent professional English is required for design documentation, deliverables and steering-committee communication. Business-level Japanese is a strong advantage - many process owners, shop-floor personnel and legacy-system custodians work primarily in Japanese, and much current-state documentation exists only in Japanese - but it is not a condition of appointment. Interpretation support, bilingual design documentation and pairing with bilingual business analysts are provided, and strong candidates will be considered regardless of Japanese-language ability. description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Medovate Pvt Ltd is building a Technology and Operations Centre in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud services for a multi\-entity international group operating manufacturing and distribution businesses across the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China, and India. The group runs Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and SCM across multiple legal entities, inventory organizations, and business units, with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Fusion to intercompany order flows, warehouse operations, e\-commerce platforms, and third\-party logistics partners.
 



**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are seeking a Junior Oracle SCM Functional Consultant to join the Supply Chain practice at Medovate's Ahmedabad center. This is a hands\-on functional role suited to someone early in their Oracle Fusion career who wants to build real module depth rather than remain in a single support queue. You will work under the direction of the SCM Functional Lead and alongside senior consultants, supporting configuration, testing, data preparation, and day to day functional support across Inventory Management, Product Management, Procurement, Order Management, and Cost Management. You will be given structured work, clear design decisions to execute against, and progressively broader exposure as you demonstrate capability.
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Configuration and Delivery Support** 



* Perform configuration tasks across Oracle Fusion SCM modules in line with design decisions agreed by the SCM Functional Lead.
* Participate in requirements and discovery sessions with supply chain, warehouse, and procurement stakeholders, taking accurate notes and preparing follow up questions.
* Prepare configuration workbooks, setup checklists, and functional documentation for review by senior consultants.
* Assist with the setup of inventory organizations, sub inventories, locators, and item organization assignments across multiple legal entities.
* Support environment refresh activities by re applying and validating configuration in test and development pods.



**Inventory Management** 



* Support configuration of transaction types, reservations, lot and serial control, and inter organization transfer setups.
* Assist with cycle count and physical inventory setup, count sequence generation, and adjustment processing.
* Investigate inventory balance and transaction discrepancies, escalating root cause findings to senior consultants.
* Support min max planning, replenishment, and reorder setup for stocked items.



**Product Management** 



* Assist with item class structures, item templates, attribute groups, and catalogue setup.
* Prepare and validate item master data loads using FBDI and spreadsheet templates.
* Support item lifecycle phase transitions and item organization assignment across group entities.
* Maintain item level attribute accuracy including units of measure, category assignments, and cross references.



**Procurement** 



* Support configuration of purchasing document styles, approval hierarchies, and supplier setup.
* Assist with blanket purchase agreement and price list maintenance, including validation of pricing against agreed terms.
* Support requisition to purchase order flow testing, including self service procurement scenarios.
* Prepare supplier and supplier site data for load and validate results after import.



**Order Management** 



* Support order orchestration process testing, including hold, change order, and fulfilment line scenarios.
* Assist with pricing, shipping, and transaction type setup for domestic and export order flows.
* Support intercompany purchase order and sales order flows between group entities, including validation of generated documents.
* Investigate stuck or errored orders and prepare findings for resolution by senior consultants.



**Cost Management and Shipping** 



* Support cost organization, cost book, and valuation unit setup activities.
* Assist with receipt accounting and cost accounting period close tasks, including exception review.
* Support pick, pack, and ship transaction testing, including shipping document generation and receipt confirmation.



**Testing and Data** 



* Execute test scripts during SIT and UAT cycles, log defects with clear reproduction steps, and retest fixes.
* Prepare test data sets and support data conversion activities, including reconciliation of loaded records against source extracts.
* Validate reports and BI queries against transactional data and flag inconsistencies.



**Support and Documentation** 



* Provide first and second line functional support for SCM users across group entities, working within agreed service levels.
* Maintain configuration logs, issue trackers, and knowledge base articles.
* Prepare user guides and quick reference material for warehouse, procurement, and order management users.
* Raise and track service requests with Oracle Support under the guidance of senior team members.



**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Commerce, Operations, or a related discipline.
* One to three years of experience working with Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM in a functional, support, or implementation capacity.
* Working exposure to at least two of Inventory Management, Product Management, Procurement, Order Management, or Cost Management.
* Understanding of core supply chain processes including procure to pay, order to cash, and inventory transaction flows.
* Practical experience preparing and loading data using FBDI templates or spreadsheet loaders.
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data validation for reconciliation work.
* Clear written English and the ability to document configuration and issues precisely.
* Willingness to work on site in Ahmedabad and to overlap with UK and US business hours when required.



**Preferred** 



* Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM certification in one or more modules.
* Exposure to multi entity, multi organization, or multi currency Oracle environments.
* Experience supporting intercompany order flows between related legal entities.
* Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud delivered interfaces from a functional testing perspective.
* Exposure to manufacturing, discrete assembly, or distribution operations.
* Awareness of BI Publisher or OTBI report structures.
* Experience working alongside warehouse teams on receiving, putaway, picking, or cycle count processes.



**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Structured mentoring from senior Oracle Fusion consultants and functional leads.
* Exposure to a full multi entity Oracle Fusion footprint across five countries rather than a single narrow support scope.
* A clear progression path into a mid level functional consultant role based on demonstrated capability.

description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React \+ Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full\-time and fully remote opportunity!
   

  

**The work:**
 We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early\-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982\.
   

  

 This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
   

  

**Who we hire — the DNA:**
* Self\-starters and do\-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show\-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI\-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed\-systems literate. High\-efficiency, event\-driven, low\-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well\-rounded, smart people who move fast


**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**
* Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide\-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per\-module panels
* This is the product wedge — what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes."
* Real\-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1\-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward.


**What you'll own:**
* React app \+ Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page\-overlay pill)
* WebSocket\-driven real\-time UI
* plugin / module\-federation patterns
* Screen\-real\-estate management
* The design system in code
* Your committed timelines.


**Who you are:**
* A self\-starter with a show\-me mentality — you move from prototype to real\-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups
* You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes
* Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature — consistency is what keeps a small team fast
* You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity
* You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning.


**What You Will Bring:**
* 7\+ years frontend; senior\-level React \+ TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all \+\+\+\+ —
* You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering).
* Strong design/UI skills a \+\+\+ — you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand.
* Real Chrome Extension experience — Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote.
* Strong API skills — you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync.
* Heavy WebSocket / real\-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream.
* Plugin / module\-federation or dynamic\-component\-loading experience.
* Performance as a habit — render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub\-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck.
* State management under streaming data — optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution.
* Extension security fluency — CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak.
* Automated UI testing (Playwright\-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff.
* Accessibility and keyboard\-first flows as defaults — agents live in this UI 8 hours a day.
* A master debugger in the browser — DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash.
* Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it).

description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To Team**
 Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high\-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
   

  

 Our team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II for our Tax and Regulatory Platforms. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to build and support the Global Tax Platform and Unified Regulatory Platform for the travel industry.
   

  

 These highly resilient systems must scale to process Expedia Group's entire business transactions in real time, while adapting to ever\-changing regulations across global markets. They power complete transaction lifecycles from shopping through booking, invoicing, accounting, filing, reporting, and beyond with financial\-grade accuracy and robust audit trails.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to take a pivotal role in building the travel industry's premier commerce and financial platforms. You will design and implement APIs, data streams, real\-time compute, and data lake storage at scale pushing the boundaries of cloud technologies including Kafka, Kubernetes, gRPC, Apache Spark, and Flink.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
**Core Engineering**
* Work in small, agile teams to design, develop, test, and maintain scalable and resilient services across the Tax and Regulatory Platform
* Build and operate cloud\-native streaming data, real\-time processing, and data lake platforms at scale using Kafka, Kubernetes, Apache Spark, and Flink
* Ensure all software meets the highest standards of performance, security, scalability, and financial\-grade accuracy
* Review pull requests and lead by example on code quality refactoring for readability, extensibility, and testability
* Leverage CI/CD techniques and tools to maximise delivery speed, reliability, and operational confidence
* Embrace change always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today
* Support ever\-changing global regulatory requirements by building adaptable, configurable platform components that reduce time\-to\-compliance in new markets
* Drive observability and reliability across services using DataDog, Splunk, or equivalent tooling ensuring proactive detection and resolution of issues
* Share knowledge, mentor peers, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning including AI fluency across the engineering team


**AI \& Intelligent Systems**
* Design and integrate AI\-powered capabilities into regulatory and financial workflows including intelligent document processing, automated compliance checks, and anomaly detection
* Build and maintain RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines connecting internal knowledge sources, regulatory datasets, and transaction data to LLM\-powered services for accurate, context\-aware outputs
* Integrate and manage model inference endpoints into production services, ensuring low latency, high availability, and cost\-efficient serving at scale
* Experiment with and adopt AI developer tooling leveraging tools like GitHub Copilot and Claude to accelerate engineering velocity across the team
* Apply responsible AI practices in compliance\-sensitive contexts including prompt engineering, hallucination mitigation, output validation, and audit trail requirements
* Collaborate with data science and ML teams to translate model outputs into reliable, production\-grade engineering solutions aligned to regulatory standards.


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* 3\+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering
* Java preferred Experienced software developer with strong system design, problem\-solving, and object\-oriented coding skills
* AWS, Kubernetes/Containerisation, and Apache Spark/Streaming preferredExperience developing in cloud environments
* Experience delivering and supporting highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant distributed systems
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across cross\-functional teams
* Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or Splunk
* Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable delivery


**AI Fluency \& Emerging Technologies**
* Foundational understanding of AI/ML concepts and how large language models (LLMs) are applied in production engineering contexts
* Hands\-on or working knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns including vector stores, embedding models, and knowledge retrieval pipelines
* Familiarity with model inference, including serving frameworks (e.g. TorchServe, TGI, vLLM) and integrating inference endpoints into production services
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-powered developer tooling — GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar and applying them to accelerate engineering workflows
* Awareness of responsible AI practices prompt engineering, hallucination mitigation, and guardrails in regulated or compliance\-sensitive environments
* Curiosity to explore how AI capabilities can be embedded into regulatory and financial platforms from intelligent document processing to anomaly detection and automated compliance checks
* Passionate about continuous learning including AI fluency and sharing knowledge with the broader team

title: Sr. Software Engineer (UI Developer)
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking a skilled Sr. Software Engineer to drive the high\-quality component delivery of the Ethos Design System (EDS).
   

  

 The UI Developer for EDS is a craftsman of the modern web platform. You are not building simple web pages; you are building the "Lego blocks" that the rest of the enterprise builds upon. You will specialize in Lit (Web Components) to create agnostic, future\-proof UI elements that function seamlessly in React, Angular, and Vue environments. Your code must be bulletproof, accessible, and performant, serving as the gold standard for thousands of developers across GE HealthCare.
   

  

 GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world\-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About EDS**
 EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare’s global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle," EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety.
   

  

**The Mission: Scale and Empowerment**
 We are in a phase of hyper\-growth, scaling from 15 adopting products to over 100\. This requires a leader who thinks like a founder. You must look beyond simple backlog management to think about scale, growth, and empowerment. You will build a self\-service ecosystem that allows teams to move fast without breaking the consistent standards required for patient safety and accessibility.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Component Engineering \& API Design
* Web Component Development: Develop robust, encapsulated UI components using the Lit library. You will write clean, semantic HTML and scoped CSS (SASS).
* Component API Architecture: You are responsible for writing clean, intuitive Component APIs. You define the Inputs (Props), Outputs (Events), and Slots that allow thousands of other developers to consume your code easily.
* Cross\-Framework Integration: You are responsible for the "Wrapper Layer." You will test and optimize your components to ensure they integrate seamlessly into React, Angular, and Vue applications.
* Design Fidelity \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Cross\-Functional Team: Work daily within a cross\-functional team comprising Architects, Product owners, LSD (Lead System Designers), DevOps, and QA. You ensure your components align with the broader architecture and CI/CD standards.
* Figma Proficiency: You will leverage Figma’s Dev Mode to inspect layers, extract properties, and ensure implementation matches the exact specifications of the design team.
* Accessibility Governance: You are a champion of inclusive design. You ensure every component complies with WCAG 2\.1 AA standards, including keyboard navigation, screen reader support (ARIA), and color contrast.
* Agile Execution \& Documentation
* Agile Rigor: Participate actively in Agile ceremonies. You are responsible for managing your work items in Rally, ensuring accurate status updates and story point estimation.
* Testing Rigor: You are responsible for writing comprehensive Unit Test Cases (using tools like ViTest or Jest).
* Technical Documentation: You treat documentation as part of the code. You contribute to Storybook, writing clear usage examples and technical integration guides.


**Core Competencies \& Soft Skills**
* Communicating Trade\-offs \& Alignment: Clearly explains technical options, trade\-offs, and risks for the features and components they own. Collaborates closely with peer engineers, UX, and product to align on approach and get to a shared decision.
* Technical Ownership: Acts as the go\-to owner for the design and implementation of the components/features they build within the UI and Design System platform. Takes full accountability for their work from design through delivery and maintenance and contributes actively to broader architectural discussions.
* Applied AI for Development: Uses AI\-assisted engineering for refactoring, testing, migrations, documentation, debugging, and code review as part of daily workflow. Understands model selection and context/token management and follows team\-level AI development practices (validation, security, human\-review controls) to consistently improve their own productivity.
* Evidence\-Based Direction: Raises concerns and proposes improvements to existing approaches when justified, backing suggestions with data or concrete examples rather than opinion alone.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
* Experience: 5–8 years of experience in front\-end development.
+ Mandatory: Proven experience building Enterprise Software applications.

* UX Collaboration: Mandatory: 3\+ years of experience working closely with UX Designers. You must demonstrate proficiency using Figma's Dev Mode.
* Technical Stack:
+ Mandatory: Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript.
+ Mandatory: Deep understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and SASS architecture.
+ Mandatory: Proficiency using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Codex, GH Copilot, Claude) as part of your daily coding workflow, from writing and reviewing code to debugging and documentation.
+ Preferred: Hands\-on experience with Lit or native Web Components.

* Agile \& Process:
+ Mandatory: Proficiency working in Agile environments and using Rally.
+ Experience writing Unit Tests (Jest, ViTest) and documentation (Storybook).


**Inclusion And Diversity**
 GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviours: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.
   

  

 Our
 **total rewards** 
 are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world\-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 No

Industry: Software Development

Job Type: Full\-time



We’re hiring fullstack engineers (SDE\-2 through Staff) to own this surface end\-to\-end: from rich, reactive frontends to backend services and workflows that power them.



What changes across levels is scope, ambiguity, and influence — but at every level, you’ll write code, ship product, and operate across the frontend\-backend boundary.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Frontend Development**



Design and build intuitive, high\-quality user interfaces that handle complex workflows — task tracking, state transitions, approvals, and user actions.



Senior and Staff engineers define reusable patterns and UI primitives for teams.


### **Fullstack Feature Ownership**



Own features across the stack:


* Build React frontends
* Design and implement APIs
* Ensure seamless integration between UI and backend systems


SDE\-2s execute with guidance, Seniors own end\-to\-end design, Staff engineers define system\-wide patterns.


### **Backend \& Service Layer**



Build and evolve backend services that support:


* Long\-running workflows
* State management and persistence
* Error handling and fallback strategies
* Scalable API design

### **Real\-Time \& Event\-Driven Systems**



Implement real\-time patterns using WebSockets, SSE, or async workflows:


* Live updates
* Progress tracking
* Partial results and responsiveness


Make tradeoffs around latency, consistency, and user experience.


### **User Control \& Workflow Design**



Build systems that allow users to:


* Review and approve actions
* Override system decisions
* Intervene in workflows when needed


Senior\+ engineers help define how control, automation, and usability are balanced.


### **Performance \& Reliability**



Optimize across the stack:


* UI performance and rendering
* Backend query efficiency
* Caching and throughput
* System reliability and observability


Senior and Staff engineers define SLOs and performance standards.


### **Code Quality \& Mentorship**


* Write clean, testable, maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews
* Mentor junior engineers (Senior\+)
* Establish engineering standards (Staff)

### **Cross\-Team Technical Leadership (Senior \& Staff)**



Collaborate across frontend, backend, data, and platform teams to:


* Define shared patterns and abstractions
* Resolve architectural ambiguity
* Align engineering decisions with product goals


Staff engineers drive org\-wide technical direction.



 The **SDE\-2** level typically requires **3–5 years of full\-stack experience**, with strong skills in React and TypeScript on the frontend and experience with API design and basic database concepts on the backend. Candidates should have exposure to complex workflows, be familiar with asynchronous and real\-time patterns, understand user flows, and execute well\-scoped work effectively. Communication should be clear and structured.



The **Senior** level generally requires **5–8 years of full\-stack experience**, along with deep React expertise and strong backend systems knowledge, including queues, caching, and authentication. Candidates are expected to have built production\-grade systems and demonstrate strong architectural judgment, particularly around real\-time systems. They should be capable of designing for edge cases, evaluating tradeoffs, making independent technical decisions, and clearly communicating those tradeoffs across teams.



The **Staff** level typically requires **9\+ years of full\-stack experience** and expert\-level frontend architecture skills. Candidates should have deep expertise in distributed systems and infrastructure design, with experience designing large\-scale systems and defining real\-time infrastructure patterns. They are expected to shape both product and technology direction, provide organization\-level technical leadership, and effectively bridge business, product, and engineering teams.

  


**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience with real\-time UI updates and streaming data
* Familiarity with system evaluation and testing frameworks
* Experience in high\-stakes domains (fintech, logistics, etc.)
* Contributions to open\-source or internal tooling
* Experience scaling systems from early stage to maturity *(Staff)*

ReactJS, Javascript
