Apply agile and scrum practices to build secure high quality solutions that support consumer lending and other enterprise business functions while improving customer experience and operational efficiency.
  
Responsibilities
  
Design and develop complex net based web applications using c sharp entity framework and rest api principles to deliver secure and scalable solutions for enterprise business needs.
  
Implement rich client side functionality using angular ten plus typescript javascript html css three point zero and bootstrap to create accessible and responsive user interfaces that comply with w three c web standards.
  
Collaborate with product owners business analysts and cross functional engineering teams in an agile and scrum environment to refine user stories estimate effort and plan iterative deliveries that align with business priorities.
  
Optimize application performance and reliability by profiling code tuning t sql queries and improving entity framework data access patterns to ensure efficient use of database and cloud resources.
  
Integrate azure services such as app services storage and monitoring tools into net applications to enhance scalability observability and maintainability across hybrid deployment environments.
  
Apply secure coding practices and web standards compliance in all front end and back end components to reduce defects improve accessibility and support inclusive digital experiences for diverse customer groups.
  
Conduct thorough code reviews and unit testing using industry standard frameworks to validate functionality maintain coding best practices and support continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.
  
Work closely with quality engineering and operations teams to troubleshoot production issues analyze root causes and implement robust fixes that strengthen system stability and user trust.
  
Document technical designs api contracts and implementation details in a clear and structured manner so that other engineers can easily understand maintain and extend the solution.
  
Contribute to continuous improvement of agile processes by suggesting enhancements to sprint planning backlog grooming and review activities that increase delivery predictability and stakeholder satisfaction.
  
Participate in feature grooming sessions for consumer lending and related domains by translating functional needs into clear technical approaches that improve decision accuracy and customer transparency.
  
Align daily engineering activities with the organization purpose of delivering responsible and efficient financial services by building software that supports fair lending practices and simplifies digital interactions.
  
Provide technical guidance to peers on angular patterns net framework usage and azure integration options so that the broader team can adopt consistent approaches and reduce rework across projects.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Bring strong experience in net and net framework development using c sharp entity framework rest api design and t sql so that complex business logic and data workflows can be implemented reliably.
  
Demonstrate proficiency in modern web development using angular ten plus typescript javascript html css three point zero bootstrap and w three c compliant web standards to deliver accessible and responsive front end experiences.
  
Apply practiced knowledge of agile methodologies and scrum ceremonies to manage work items collaborate effectively and support incremental delivery of high value features to business stakeholders.
  
Utilize hands on expertise with azure cloud capabilities including hosting configuration and monitoring to design solutions that scale across hybrid environments while remaining secure and maintainable.
  
Draw on experience in consumer lending or related financial services domains as a nice to have capability to better understand credit products regulatory considerations and customer expectations.

title: DCO Front End Developer
description:
**About WPP Production**
 We are WPP Production \- the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world\-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi\-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a DCO Frontend Developer with a strong foundation in dynamic creative (DCO) implementations to build scalable, high\-performance digital ad experiences across web, display, social, and video environments. This role focuses primarily on frontend engineering, component\-based architecture, performance optimization, and responsive creative development, while also supporting dynamic creative integrations, feed\-driven logic, and campaign activation workflows. You will collaborate closely with creative, media, and product teams to translate design concepts into robust, reusable frontend solutions that power personalized and data\-driven advertising experiences
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design and develop high\-quality, performant frontend applications and ad creatives using modern web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript).
* Build and maintain modular, reusable, and scalable creative templates and UI components.
* Ensure cross\-browser, cross\-device compatibility and responsive/adaptive design across all environments.
* Optimize assets for performance, load speed, and runtime efficiency, especially in constrained ad\-serving environments.
* Integrate dynamic data feeds (JSON, XML, CSV, APIs) to enable personalization and content variation.
* Implement and manage basic DCO logic, including creative variations, dynamic content insertion, and conditional rendering.
* Collaborate with designers to translate Figma/Adobe designs into pixel\-perfect, interactive experiences.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues across browsers, devices, and ad platforms.
* Participate in code reviews, version control workflows, and frontend best practices implementation.
* Work with cross\-functional teams (creative, media, production) to ensure smooth delivery and deployment of campaigns.
* Support campaign launches and QA, ensuring accuracy and functionality of dynamic creatives.


**Requirements** 
**:**
* Strong experience in HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Experience building responsive and adaptive UIs across devices and screen sizes.
* Proficiency with JavaScript animation libraries such as GSAP, CreateJS, or similar.
* Familiarity with component\-based architecture and reusable design systems.
* Strong understanding of performance optimization techniques (lazy loading, asset compression, efficient DOM manipulation).
* Experience with cross\-browser compatibility and debugging tools.
* Working knowledge of Git and version control workflows.
* Experience with SASS/SCSS and modern CSS methodologies.
* Familiarity with Figma and design\-to\-development workflows.
* Understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and W3C standards.


**Nice to Haves:**
* Experience with creative tools such as Adobe Animate, After Effects, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
* Exposure to dynamic ad platforms like Celtra, Innovid, or Smartly.
* Knowledge of video ad formats (VAST/VPAID) and rich media creatives.
* Understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystem fundamentals.
* Familiarity with basic backend/API integration concepts for data\-driven experiences.
* Interest or exposure to AI/automation in frontend or creative workflows.


**Technical Skills**
* Core: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Styling: SASS/SCSS, responsive design
* Animation: GSAP, CreateJS
* Data Handling: JSON, XML, CSV
* Tools: Git, Figma, Adobe Suite
* Standards: WCAG, W3C, cross\-browser compatibility.


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.
   

  

**Inclusion and Impact**
 WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**Data**
 We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
   

  

**Please contact careers@wppproduction.com if you need the job advert or form in another format.**

 Chennai

 **\*\*change control\*\***

 **\*\*solution scalability\*\***

title: Java React and Oracle Developer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Role overview**
-----------------


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Applications Development Programmer Analyst to join our global Technology team. In this collaborative role, you will contribute to the design, development, and implementation of robust, high\-performance software applications. Utilizing your expertise in Java, React, and Oracle database technologies, you will solve complex technical challenges, optimize system functionality, and deliver high\-quality solutions that support our core business operations.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* **Full\-stack development:**Design, build, and maintain responsive front\-end user interfaces using React and secure, scalable back\-end services using Java.
* **Database management:**Design, optimize, and maintain relational database schemas, complex queries, and stored procedures within Oracle databases.
* **Software development lifecycle:**Participate actively in all phases of the development process, including systems analysis, technical design, coding, testing, implementation, and post\-deployment support.
* **Systems analysis and planning:**Conduct feasibility studies, prepare time and cost estimates, and contribute to risk technology and IT planning initiatives.
* **Security and compliance:**Recommend and implement robust security measures during system design and post\-implementation reviews to safeguard client and firm assets.
* **Collaboration and consulting:**Partner with business users, clients, and cross\-functional technology groups to analyze requirements, recommend advanced programming solutions, and resolve technical issues.
* **Mentorship:**Serve as a technical advisor and coach to junior analysts, promoting best practices and fostering team growth.
* **Risk management:**Appropriately assess risk when making technical and business decisions, ensuring compliance with applicable policies, laws, and regulations.

**Technical skills and qualifications**
---------------------------------------


* **Experience:** 7\+ years of professional experience in software applications programming and systems analysis.

 We are looking for skilled Frontend Developers and Senior Frontend Developers to design and develop scalable, high\-performance web applications using React and Next.js. Candidates with MERN Stack experience are also encouraged to apply.
 



 Depending on experience and technical expertise, you will contribute to or lead frontend architecture decisions, develop high\-quality applications, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, mentor junior engineers where applicable, and drive best practices across the frontend codebase.
 



 This role also requires comfort using AI\-assisted development tools and evaluating AI\-generated output for quality, security, and performance.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 • Architect, build, and maintain scalable, production\-grade applications using React and Next.js (App Router, SSR, SSG, ISR).

 • Translate Figma/design system files into reusable, accessible, and well\-tested components.
 



 • Mentor junior and mid\-level developers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, where applicable.
 



 • Drive and contribute to testing strategies, including unit, integration, and E2E testing using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
 



 • Partner with product managers and designers to scope features, estimate effort, and identify technical tradeoffs.
 



 • Stay current with the React/Next.js ecosystem and evaluate new tools, libraries, and AI\-assisted workflows for team adoption.
 



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




 • Minimum 3\+ years of professional experience in Frontend Development or MERN Stack Development.
 



 • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript.
 



 • Strong hands\-on experience with React (Hooks, Context API, component design patterns) and Next.js (App Router/Pages Router, SSR, SSG, ISR, API routes).
 



 • Strong understanding of state management solutions such as Redux, Zustand, React Query/TanStack Query, or similar.
 



 • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and CSS frameworks/tools such as Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules.
 



 • Experience optimizing web performance and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP).
 



 • Experience working with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL, including authentication methods such as JWT and OAuth.
 



 • Practical hands\-on experience using AI coding tools such as Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools in a real development workflow, with the ability to review, correct, and validate AI\-generated code.
 



 • Strong understanding of testing concepts and experience with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
 



 • Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows, including GitHub/GitLab, code reviews, and CI/CD.
 



 • Experience with web accessibility standards, including WCAG and ARIA.
 



 • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



  





**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




 • Experience with MERN Stack technologies, including MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js.
 



 • Exposure to backend or full\-stack development using Node.js for closer collaboration on API design and development.
 



 • Experience integrating AI/LLM features into frontend applications, such as chat interfaces, streaming responses, and prompt\-driven UI.
 



 • Experience with cloud and deployment platforms such as Vercel, AWS, or Azure.
 



 • Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading a small team.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 



  





**SOFT SKILLS** 




 • Strong ownership mindset and the ability to work independently on ambiguous problems.
 



 • Product\-oriented thinking — considers the end user, not just the ticket.
 



 • Effective mentor and communicator, comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback.
 



 • Comfortable pushing back on design or product decisions with data\-backed reasoning.

Auditmann is a SaaS-based software platform designed for CA firms in India to simplify and automate their day-to-day accounting, auditing, and tax-related tasks. The platform aims to streamline processes such as Schedule III financial statement preparation, TDS, GST and Income Tax audit procedures, and automatic generation of Tax Audit Reports , helping CA firms improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. We are looking for a Front-End Engineer who can both design and build a modern, intuitive, and scalable user interface for Auditmann's SaaS platform. This is not a pure implementation role, we expect the candidate to think through UI/UX decisions themselves, not just execute designs handed to them. 
 Key Responsibilities Design and develop responsive, user-friendly, and visually appealing web interfaces for the Auditmann SaaS platform, end to end, from concept to code. Independently design screen layouts, workflows, and component structures for new features, rather than relying solely on a separate design team or pre-made mockups. Develop reusable and scalable UI components using Next.js and modern front-end technologies . Translate business requirements directly into well-designed, functional, high-quality web applications , making sound UI/UX decisions along the way. Work closely with the product and backend teams to define and create smooth, intuitive user experiences. Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and other backend services . Manage application state effectively using Redux or other state-management solutions . Ensure consistency in UI components, layouts, navigation, forms, dashboards, tables, and data-heavy screens. Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility . Identify and resolve UI/UX issues, bugs, and performance bottlenecks. Take ownership of the overall usability and user experience of the platform, not just its implementation. Collaborate with the team to continuously improve existing features and design new product functionalities. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern front-end development . Hands-on experience with Next.js and React.js. Solid grasp of UI/UX principles and the ability to design clean, usable interfaces independently, not just code from a provided design. Understanding of REST APIs, API integration, request/response handling, and authentication . Good understanding of Redux and state management concepts . Experience working with reusable UI components and design systems. Understanding of Git/version control and basic software development workflows. Ability to go from a rough idea or requirement straight to a functional, well-designed interface, with or without a wireframe provided. Good problem-solving and debugging skills. Ability to work in a startup environment and take ownership of assigned tasks. 
 Good to Have Experience working on SaaS products, dashboards, or B2B applications . Experience with accounting, taxation, audit, or finance-related software. Proficiency in Figma or similar design tools, for prototyping and design handoff. Knowledge of TypeScript. Experience with UI component libraries such as Material UI, Ant Design, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS , etc. Understanding of basic accessibility and web performance practices. 
 What You'll Work On As part of the product development team, you will design and build interfaces for features such as: Financial statement preparation dashboards Schedule III financial statements TDS, GST & Income Tax audit workflows Tax Audit Report generation Client and engagement management Data-entry and review interfaces Reports, tables and analytics dashboards Automated task/workflow management CA firm and client-facing dashboards 
 Ideal Candidate We're looking for someone who is strong technically but also thinks like a designer , someone who doesn't just wait for a Figma file, but can look at a complex business requirement and independently work out the simplest, most intuitive interface to solve it, then build it. Since Auditmann is a startup, the candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of both design and engineering decisions, experimenting with solutions, and collaborating closely with the founding/product team . 
 Why Join Booksmann? Opportunity to work on a real-world SaaS product solving problems for CA firms across India. Full ownership over both the design and the code of what you build, not just implementation. Work closely with the product and technology team. title: App Developer – React Native / React.js
description:
**Role Overview** 




 Durolt Technologies Pvt. Ltd., the technology arm of the Fonzel group, builds and operates a cloud\-based smart locker platform used across Indian Railways, hospitality, financial institutions, and corporate/institutional clients. We are looking for a Junior App Developer to join our Pune\-based product engineering team and work on the mobile, tablet, and Progressive Web App (PWA) applications that power the Durolt locker ecosystem.
 



 This role is suited to a developer with 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in React Native and/or React.js who is looking to grow under the guidance of senior developers, contribute to live product features, and build a strong foundation in mobile\-first, cloud\-first application development.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 •     Develop and maintain mobile and tablet applications using the React Native framework for Android and iOS, under the guidance of senior developers.
 



 •     Build and maintain Progressive Web App (PWA) modules using React.js.
 



 •     Integrate REST APIs to connect app screens with the Durolt backend and tenant portal services.
 



 •     Assist in integrating third\-party services such as Email, SMS, Payment Gateway, and FCM for push notifications.
 



 •     Support testing and debugging, and resolve bugs identified by QA or reported in production.
 



 •     Participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies – sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and sprint reviews.
 



 •     Collaborate closely with QA engineers, backend developers, and the Product team to ship features on schedule.
 



 •     Assist with app builds, releases, and version upgrades on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
 



 •     Write clean, well\-documented code following team coding standards, and use Git for version control.
 



 •     Stay current with React Native/React.js updates and proactively suggest improvements to app performance and user experience.
 



**Requirements \& Qualifications** 




 •     1–3 years of experience in React Native and/or React.js development (strong internship or project experience considered for candidates at the lower end of this range).
 



 •     Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and core React concepts – components, hooks, and state management.
 



 •     Basic understanding of REST API integration and asynchronous data handling.
 



 •     Exposure to native Android (Java/Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) is an added advantage, not mandatory.
 



 •     Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
 



 •     Basic understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.
 



 •     Willingness to learn cloud services (AWS Lambda, CloudWatch, RDS) and IoT\-related integrations relevant to smart locker devices.
 



 •     Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on project experience).
 



**Domain Exposure – Smart Locker / IoT Stack (Good to Have)** 




 Durolt's app runs on kiosk tablets embedded in physical locker hardware, so the platform goes deeper than a typical mobile app — offline\-first data, MQTT\-based device communication, and direct hardware integration. As a Junior App Developer you are not expected to have production experience across all of the areas below; you'll work under a senior developer's guidance to build this depth over time. Prior exposure, coursework, or personal\-project familiarity with any of these is a strong plus and will fast\-track your growth into a mid\-level role.
 



**1\. Offline\-first \& local database** 




 •     SQLite hands\-on: react\-native\-sqlite\-storage, op\-sqlite, WatermelonDB or Realm
 



 •     Schema migrations without data loss on already\-deployed devices
 



 •     Sync engine: outbox/queue pattern, retries with backoff, idempotency keys
 



 •     Conflict resolution, clock skew, soft deletes/tombstones
 



 •     Encryption at rest (SQLCipher / encrypted Realm)
 



 •     Data retention and purge so the DB doesn't grow unbounded on kiosk devices
 



**2\. MQTT \& realtime** 




 •     MQTT 3\.1\.1/5, QoS levels, and when each matters for a lock command
 



 •     Topic design, retained messages, Last Will \& Testament for offline detection
 



 •     Persistent sessions, reconnect with backoff, keepalive tuning
 



 •     TLS, per\-device credentials, broker ACLs
 



 •     MQTT over WebSocket; comparison with WebSocket/SSE/polling
 



 •     Command acknowledgement and de\-duplication (a locker must not open twice)
 



 •     Brokers: Mosquitto, EMQX, HiveMQ, AWS IoT Core
 



**3\. Works\-without\-cloud behaviour** 




 •     Local\-only unlock flow, cached permissions, queued audit logs when the cloud is unreachable
 



 •     Device\-to\-controller comms on LAN (local REST, TCP, on\-prem MQTT broker)
 



 •     Feature flags / remote config to change behaviour without a store release
 



**4\. Hardware \& peripheral integration** 




 •     BLE (react\-native\-ble\-plx), NFC/RFID readers, QR/barcode scanning
 



 •     Camera pipeline for face capture, on\-device liveness/quality checks
 



 •     Thermal/label printers, USB serial or OTG for relay boards and locker controllers
 



 •     Background tasks, foreground services, wake locks, boot\-time auto\-start
 



 •     Kiosk mode / device\-owner / lock task mode, MDM (Scalefusion, Knox, Android Enterprise)
 



**5\. Native layer depth** 




 •     Gradle, ProGuard/R8, ABI splits, signing; Xcode, CocoaPods, provisioning, entitlements
 



 •     Writing native modules and bridging vendor SDKs; JSI / Turbo Modules, New Architecture
 



 •     Debugging native crashes, not just JS errors
 



**6\. Security** 




 •     Android Keystore / iOS Keychain, no secrets in the bundle
 



 •     Certificate pinning, short\-lived tokens for kiosk devices
 



 •     Root/jailbreak and tamper detection, screen recording protection
 



 •     Biometric/PII handling and consent (relevant given face auth)
 



**7\. APM \& observability** 




 •     Sentry / Crashlytics / Bugsnag with source map upload in CI
 



 •     Crash\-free session rate, ANR tracking, release health per version
 



 •     Offline log buffering with later upload, remote log pull from field devices
 



 •     Custom events: unlock attempt, unlock success, sync failure, hardware timeout
 



 •     Error boundaries and graceful degradation when network or hardware is unavailable
 



**8\. Release engineering** 




 •     OTA updates (CodePush / EAS Update) and knowing what cannot ship OTA
 



 •     Fastlane or EAS pipelines, staged rollouts, forced\-upgrade handling for fleets
 



 •     Old app versions still talking to the current API
 



**9\. Testing depth** 




 •     Jest \+ React Native Testing Library; Detox or Maestro for E2E
 



 •     Testing offline paths and hardware failures with mocks
 



 •     Physical low\-end Android device testing, not just simulators
 



**10\. Kiosk UX** 




 •     Accessibility, large\-touch layouts, multi\-language
 



 •     Clear offline/error states for a user standing at a locker
 



**11\. Performance** 




 •     Hermes, bundle size, startup time (matters on cheap kiosk tablets)
 



**What We Offer** 




 •     The opportunity to work on Durolt's smart locker and IoT platform, deployed with enterprise clients such as Railways, Nayara Energy, Nokia, Bharat Electronics Limited, and the Aditya Birla Group.
 



 •     Hands\-on mentorship from senior developers and exposure to the complete mobile app development lifecycle.
 



 •     A collaborative, fast\-paced product engineering environment.
 



 •     Competitive compensation package.
 



 •     Learning and growth opportunities across mobile, cloud, and IoT technologies.
 



**How to Apply** 




 Please send your updated resume, along with a portfolio or GitHub link, to contact@fonzel.com with the subject line “Application – App Developer (React Native/React.js)”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 7 working days.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**About Company**
 Dodo Payments is the Monetisation Engine for AI\-native products. We're a Merchant of Record \+ Billing \& Monetization platform that helps SaaS, AI, and digital businesses accept payments globally, automate billing (subscriptions, usage\-based, one\-time), and stay fully compliant with taxes and regulations in 220\+ countries.
   

  

 Behind that infrastructure is a product that has to make complex financial systems feel simple. That is the part you would own.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to build the interfaces thousands of businesses use to get paid: dashboard, checkout, onboarding, billing, and analytics. This is not a role that converts Figma screens into React. You will look at a flow, question it, improve it, and ship the better version. The surfaces are genuinely hard: a subscription half\-upgraded mid\-cycle, a payout held for review, a usage meter that has to be legible to a founder at 2am.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Ownership: Own features from problem to production. Understand the problem, prototype the experience, build it, talk to the API, handle the weird states, ship it, then watch how people use it and make it better.
* Core Surfaces: Build and improve the merchant dashboard, checkout, onboarding, subscriptions and usage billing, customer management, revenue analytics, and payment and payout flows.
* Interface Craft: Own the last 10% of UI quality. Loading, error, and empty states are part of the product, not cleanup afterwards.
* 0 to 1 Product: Take new products from a rough idea to something customers use, often before there is a full spec or design.
* Systems and Reuse: Build primitives and shared components where they pay off, and know when to just ship the thing instead.
* Collaboration: Work directly with product, design, backend engineers, and founders. There is no long chain of PM to designer to frontend to QA handoffs.
* Developer Experience: Contribute to the surfaces developers touch, including docs, API keys, test mode, and our SDKs.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 2\+ years building production web applications, with strong React and TypeScript.
* Shipping Record: You have shipped real products used by real customers, not projects that ended at localhost.
* UI Quality: Demonstrable care for craft. You notice the modal that is 30px too wide and the form that technically works but feels exhausting.
* Product Judgment: You can build from a rough idea without waiting for a 20\-page spec, and you push back when something is not good enough.
* AI Fluency: You use AI heavily and still know what good code looks like. We care more about what you caught the model getting wrong than how fast you generated the first draft.
* Domain Curiosity: You do not need to arrive knowing what a chargeback flow looks like. You do need to want to understand the payments system behind the UI you are building.
* Team Spirit: Experience in startups or dynamic high\-growth environments is preferred.
* Bonus: Developer tools, fintech, dashboards, or complex B2B products.


**Why Join Us?**
* Impact: Be part of the founding team, with significant influence over the product, the interface, and the company's direction.
* Ownership: Within weeks you will have shipped something customers use. Within months there are meaningful parts of Dodo you completely own. Eventually you are in the room before there is even a design.
* Growth Potential: Immense potential for personal and professional growth as the company expands.
* Equity: Competitive salary and equity package.

 Albertsons\-Safeway Company is one of the largest food and drug retailers with 2,300\+ stores. The Albertsons\-Safeway family of brands includes prominent brands in food retailing, supported by teams across the U.S. and global capability centers.
 



  





**Position Purpose:** 




 Albertsons Companies' Supply Chain team is hiring a Senior Engineer Software \- Front End for the GCC Bangalore team. This individual contributor role will be hands\-on and will partner with engineering, design, product, architecture, business stakeholders, and distributed technology teams to deliver web and mobile capabilities for Order Management, Wholesale, and Transportation business functions.
 



 The ideal candidate is a front\-end leaning full\-stack engineer who can build production\-quality React/TypeScript user experiences, contribute to Java/Spring Boot APIs and integrations, and use AI\-assisted development tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity without compromising security, quality, or maintainability.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters:** 



* Modernize user experiences for supply chain applications such as order visibility, wholesale workflows, transportation execution, and mobile\-enabled operations.
* Reduce dependency on highly specialized legacy resources by standardizing modern web, API, mobile, and integration patterns.
* Partner with U.S. and India teams to build scalable, observable, maintainable solutions that can support high\-volume supply chain operations.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Front\-end engineering:** 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain responsive web applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SCSS, and modern component\-driven UI patterns.
* **Mobile enablement:** 
 Build or support mobile\-friendly workflows and, where needed, contribute to React Native, Flutter, or native Android/iOS implementations.
* **Full\-stack collaboration:** 
 Partner with backend engineers to integrate UI capabilities with REST APIs, Java/Spring Boot services, Kafka/event\-driven workflows, and enterprise data sources.
* **Domain delivery:** 
 Translate Supply Chain Order Management, Wholesale, and Transportation requirements into intuitive user journeys, reusable components, and reliable production features.
* **Quality ownership:** 
 Own unit, integration, end\-to\-end, accessibility, regression, and mobile testing expectations using tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or equivalent.
* **Performance and reliability:** 
 Tune front\-end performance, address browser/mobile compatibility issues, contribute to observability, and troubleshoot production issues across UI, API, and integration layers.
* **Engineering standards:** 
 Write clean, maintainable code; participate in code reviews; contribute to design reviews; and model secure development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* **AI\-assisted development:** 
 Use GitHub Copilot or similar tools for productivity, test scaffolding, refactoring, and documentation while validating generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability.
* **Team collaboration:** 
 Work effectively with peer engineers, architects, product owners, QA, SRE/DevOps, and business stakeholders across geographies.
* **Mentoring:** 
 Guide less experienced engineers on coding standards, quality practices, debugging, and front\-end architecture patterns.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 



* 5\-7 years of software engineering experience with strong hands\-on web application development.
* Strong experience with ReactJS or AngularJS; React with TypeScript is highly preferred for this front\-end role.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS/SCSS, responsive design, browser fundamentals, and accessibility\-aware UI development.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and collaborating with Java/Spring Boot microservices teams.
* Experience with SQL and data modeling concepts; familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle, Azure SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.
* Practical knowledge of test automation for web applications, including unit and end\-to\-end testing frameworks.
* Experience with Git, code review practices, and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
* Cloud exposure on Azure, GCP, or AWS, including deployment and operational support considerations.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across UI, API, data, and integration touchpoints.
* Ability to understand stakeholder expectations, clarify requirements, and escalate delivery risks early.



  





**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications:** 



* Mobile application experience with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin/Android, Swift/iOS, Android Jetpack/Compose, Appium, or Espresso.
* Exposure to Kafka, event streaming, asynchronous integration patterns, API contracts, retries, idempotency, and eventual consistency.
* Java/Spring Boot hands\-on experience sufficient to contribute to API scaffolding, debugging, integration testing, and service\-level improvements.
* NoSQL experience such as MongoDB or Cassandra, plus mobile data synchronization or offline\-first design exposure.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, observability tools, performance tuning, and production support practices.
* Supply chain, logistics, wholesale, order management, transportation, yard management, or retail technology domain experience.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot with a validation\-first engineering mindset.
* Exposure to GraphQL, design systems, micro frontends, component libraries, or modern front\-end build tooling.
* Experience with delivery of applications to users

 You will be responsible for transforming design concepts and Figma files into pixel\-perfect, responsive, high\-performance websites, while ensuring excellent usability, visual quality, and cross\-browser compatibility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Convert Figma/UI designs into pixel\-perfect, responsive frontend websites.

* Build responsive interfaces using Tailwind CSS, CSS3, HTML5, and modern frontend practices.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure accurate implementation of design systems, layouts, typography, colors, spacing, and interactions.
* Create smooth and engaging web animations and micro\-interactions.
* Develop visually impressive 3D objects and interactive 3D web experiences.
* Optimize websites for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and SEO.
* Develop and customize websites using WordPress, including theme customization and frontend integration.
* Ensure websites work consistently across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-structured code.
* Identify and resolve UI, layout, performance, and browser compatibility issues.
* Conduct testing and debugging across different browsers and devices.
* Work closely with designers, backend developers, and project managers to deliver projects on time.
* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in frontend development, UI/UX, animation, and 3D web development.


**Required Skills**
* 3–4 years of experience in frontend/web development.
* Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web design.
* Hands\-on experience with React.js and Next.js.
* Strong expertise in Tailwind CSS and modern CSS techniques.
* Excellent understanding of UI/UX principles and design implementation.
* Proven ability to convert Figma designs into production\-ready websites.
* Experience with web animations and interactive interfaces.

description:

You will be working on complex technical problems that will involve detailed analytical skills and analysis. **To be successful as a Lead Engineer, you should have experience with:**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Java JDK 17\+ \& REST (Open Api).
* Proficiency in Angular, React JS, Java scripting and HTML \& J Unit 5, Integration testing and Acceptance Testing and associated libraries.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* A self\-starter with good communication \& and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, including mentoring or leading small development teams.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The location of the role is Pune, IN.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.

* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

* User Experience — intuitive, research\-driven design solutions to enhance customer experience and retention.


**About The Role**
 We are looking for an engineer who works at the intersection of AI and complex front\-end engineering. You will design and build rich, interactive interfaces — map\-based polygon and shape editing, geometry annotation, real\-time visualization — and wire them directly into AI and ML backends and inference pipelines. This is a hands\-on role. You will be equally comfortable reasoning about model output and crafting a smooth, performant drawing surface. You will not just consume an API; you will help shape how AI capabilities surface in the product and how people interact with them.

* Design and build complex, interactive UIs — polygon and shape drawing and editing, multi\-layer canvases, draggable vertices, zoom and pan, hit\-testing, and real\-time overlays.
* Integrate front\-end experiences with AI and ML backends: inference endpoints, model serving, streaming responses, long\-running jobs, and data pipelines.

* Collaborate with ML engineers and product on what is feasible, what is fast, and what feels good to use.
* Contribute to architecture decisions and to the data contracts between the interface and the services behind it.

* JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 — including the HTML5 Canvas API, and responsive, portable styling that survives being lifted into another application.

title: Applied AI Sr Associate Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* 3–5 years of hands\-on full\-stack engineering experience with a track record of independently delivering production\-quality applications end to end; proficiency in React 18 with TypeScript (component architecture, hooks, state management with Zustand or Redux, and React Router for complex multi\-view portals), Node.js/Express for BFF APIs (including authentication flows, request proxying, caching, and structured error handling), and Python/FastAPI for backend microservices and data processing pipelines.
* Solid understanding of SQL, PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and workflow state persistence) and Redis (caching, session management, and task queue brokering via Celery or equivalent); proficiency with Docker for containerizing Node.js and Python services with identical dev/prod environments; ability to build and maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines covering lint, unit test, build, and zero\-downtime deploy on merge.
* Experience integrating with Salesforce REST APIs and SOQL — reading Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History at volume — is preferred; familiarity with Salesforce Connected App setup, OAuth 2\.0 flows, and per\-user token management; experience triggering write\-backs via Flows or Apex REST endpoints with validation gates and audit logging; exposure to Salesforce Platform Events or Pub/Sub API for real\-time case state change handling is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience integrating LLM models into production applications — prompt engineering, context management, structured output parsing, and cost control; familiarity with LangChain (Python) or equivalent orchestration frameworks for chaining LLM calls, managing memory, and enforcing guardrails; understanding of embedding\-based semantic search (text\-embedding\-ada\-002 or similar) for similarity scoring and duplicate detection; commitment to human\-in\-the\-loop design — AI assists and drafts; humans review and commit — enforced at the API layer, not just the UI.
* Proficiency with Pandas and openpyxl for Excel\-in/Excel\-out data processing pipelines; experience with fuzzy matching libraries (RapidFuzz or similar) for entity deduplication and overlap analysis; exposure to graph traversal (NetworkX or equivalent) for ownership hierarchy and relation analysis; ability to integrate with external data APIs.
* Strong grasp of REST API design principles including versioning, error contracts, pagination, and backward compatibility; ability to write well\-structured, tested code — unit tests, integration tests, and API contract tests as part of the development workflow, not an afterthought; experience maintaining an append\-only audit log tied to business entity IDs for compliance and traceability; comfortable self\-managing across frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure layers in a high\-autonomy environment within a 2\-week sprint cadence.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.


**Responsibilities**
* Build an end\-to\-end AI\-assisted operations platform that replaces manual Salesforce workflows and spreadsheet\-based processes with an auditable, intelligent console. Implement the full AI\-driven platform architecture across multiple production phases; build the React 18 \+ TypeScript portal spanning all stakeholder views; engineer the FastAPI Python workflow service with async Excel\-in/Excel\-out processing, Celery task queuing, and status polling.
* Provision and maintain the Salesforce Connected App; manage the OAuth token lifecycle; implement read operations across Cases, Accounts, Contacts, Tasks, and Activity History; build validated Salesforce write\-back flows (merge, email update, segment patch) with AI pre\-flight checks and analyst confirmation gates before any SFDC commit; implement real\-time case state monitoring via Salesforce Platform Events to drive escalation detection.
* Integrate case summarization, duplicate analysis, action pre\-flight checks, and an AI chat assistant pre\-seeded with live case context; implement the escalation prediction engine; enforce human\-in\-the\-loop guardrails at the API layer.
* Manage phased delivery with defined go\-live milestones; lead UAT sessions with analysts, managers, and leadership at each phase go\-live, and incorporate feedback into the subsequent sprint backlog; maintain Azure infrastructure, monitor application health, and own incident response throughout the build period.
* Document architecture decisions, API contracts, data schemas, and operational runbooks to support long\-term maintainability beyond the build phase.

title: React Native Developer
description:
**Job Summary**
 Sr Software Engineer will design and build high quality mobile and web applications for consumer lending products working in a hybrid day shift model. The role focuses on robust app architecture secure Rest API integration and performant user experiences using React Js and React Native while ensuring reliable delivery through GIT based collaboration and adherence to domain compliance and risk standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and architect scalable mobile applications for consumer lending solutions ensuring robust modular structures that support maintainable code and future feature growth
* Develop and enhance responsive user interfaces using React Js and React Native that deliver intuitive borrowing experiences while meeting accessibility and performance expectations
* Implement secure and well structured Rest API integrations that enable reliable data exchange between mobile clients and backend services with strong focus on consumer lending workflows
* Configure and optimize networking library usage to ensure resilient connectivity graceful error handling and efficient data transfer across diverse mobile and web environments
* Collaborate with product and domain experts to translate consumer lending requirements into technical designs that balance regulatory constraints operational risk and customer usability
* Apply version control best practices using GIT including branching merging and code review workflows to maintain high code quality and predictable release cycles in a hybrid work setting
* Conduct thorough unit integration and end to end testing of mobile and web features focusing on loan origination repayment and account management scenarios to prevent defects in production
* Investigate and resolve production issues by analyzing logs monitoring performance metrics and applying networking and API debugging techniques to restore stable experiences for lending customers
* Optimize application performance by profiling rendering flows reducing payload sizes and tuning caching strategies to support fast secure and responsive interactions for borrowers and internal teams
* Document architecture design decisions and technical implementation details in clear consumable formats so cross functional peers can understand lending flows and maintain solutions effectively
* Coordinate with security and compliance stakeholders to embed encryption validation and data protection practices into mobile architecture aligning with consumer lending regulations and organizational risk guidelines
* Mentor peers on best practices for React React Native Rest API design and mobile architecture patterns fostering a culture of clean code shared ownership and continuous improvement across the engineering group
* Participate actively in sprint planning backlog refinement and hybrid collaboration rituals to ensure delivery commitments are realistic aligned with lending business priorities and technically achievable


**Qualifications**
* Bring hands on experience in designing and implementing mobile app architecture using modern patterns such as component based structures and navigation strategies suited for complex lending journeys
* Demonstrate advanced proficiency with Rest API design and consumption including request modeling response handling and error management tailored to secure financial data exchanges
* Show strong capability in working with networking libraries to manage timeouts retries connectivity detection and secure transport enhancing reliability of mobile and web channels
* Exhibit solid skills in React Js for building modular front end components state management and routing that support rich data driven lending dashboards and workflows
* Apply deep experience with React Native to deliver high performing cross platform mobile applications leveraging native modules when needed to enrich borrower experiences
* Use GIT fluently for collaborative development including pull requests conflict resolution and release tagging ensuring stable progression of code across environments
* Leverage practical knowledge of consumer lending concepts including credit assessment loan lifecycle repayment schedules and regulatory considerations to design domain aware technical solutions

 You will join an embedded pod working directly inside a client environment on live production systems. This is not a maintenance role. * This is not a role for someone who prefers a fixed scope and stable domain. The problem domain changes.

title: Senior Manager - Frontend
description:
OverviewApplication
**Who We Are**


Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI\-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations.


**Role Summary**
================


Ontic is hiring a Senior Manager, Frontend to lead frontend teams and major frontend engineering function. This leader will be accountable for delivery, technical direction, organizational effectiveness, and the growth of technical leaders.


The role requires deep hands\-on knowledge of modern frontend technologies and architectures, coupled with strong people leadership. You will shape scalable frontend systems, establish engineering practices that improve quality and velocity, and ensure teams deliver secure, performant, accessible, and maintainable user experiences.


You will partner closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Engineering leadership to align frontend strategy, technical investments, and delivery plans with business priorities.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**Frontend Technical Leadership \& Architecture**


* Define and evolve the frontend technical strategy, architecture, and engineering standards across teams.
* Guide architectural decisions involving React, TypeScript, component architecture, state management, frontend platform capabilities, design systems, API integrations, and application structure.
* Ensure frontend systems are scalable, secure, performant, accessible, maintainable, and consistent across product areas.
* Lead technical design and architecture reviews for significant frontend initiatives.
* Identify and drive solutions for systemic technical risks, architectural inconsistencies, technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and developer productivity challenges.
* Evaluate emerging frontend technologies, frameworks, and tools, and make pragmatic adoption decisions based on business and engineering value.

**Engineering Delivery \& Execution**


* Lead planning and execution across multiple frontend teams, pods, or strategic initiatives.
* Establish clear delivery plans, milestones, operating rhythms, and accountability mechanisms.
* Balance delivery commitments, team capacity, technical investment, and organizational priorities.
* Proactively identify risks, remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and communicate trade\-offs to stakeholders.
* Improve predictability, quality, and execution consistency through strong engineering practices, metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product and Design to translate product strategy into feasible, high\-quality technical execution plans.

**People Leadership \& Team Development**


* Build, lead, and develop high\-performing frontend engineering teams.
* Coach emerging technical leaders to strengthen leadership capability across the organization.
* Own goal setting, performance reviews, career development, feedback, recognition, and performance management across teams.
* Drive structured hiring, onboarding, team design, capacity planning, and succession planning.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative, accountable, and growth\-oriented engineering culture.
* Create opportunities for engineers to build deep frontend expertise, technical ownership, and leadership skills.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Communication**


* Build strong partnerships with Product, Design, Security, Platform, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate priorities, technical direction, delivery status, risks, and decisions clearly across teams and leadership levels.
* Facilitate effective technical and organizational discussions, resolve disagreements constructively, and drive alignment on shared outcomes.
* Connect frontend technology decisions to customer experience, business value, engineering health, and organizational goals.
* Promote a culture of transparent communication, constructive feedback, and continuous learning.

**Frontend Quality, Reliability \& Developer Experience**


* Establish and evolve standards for accessibility, performance, reliability, testing, observability, and frontend security.
* Drive improvements in Core Web Vitals, browser compatibility, responsiveness, error monitoring, and production reliability.
* Promote scalable testing strategies across unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and visual regression testing.
* Improve frontend developer experience through shared tooling, CI/CD, documentation, reusable frameworks, and automation.
* Partner with Design and Platform teams to strengthen the design system and shared frontend capabilities.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================


* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial frontend engineering experience and 3\+ years leading engineering teams.
* Deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, and modern frontend development practices.
* Strong experience designing and evolving frontend architectures for large\-scale, customer\-facing SaaS applications.
* Demonstrated knowledge of component systems, design systems, state management, frontend build tooling, API integration patterns, and browser performance.
* Experience leading multiple teams, a major engineering function, or a complex product area with significant frontend scope.
* Proven ability to hire, coach, develop, and retain senior technical talent.
* Strong experience with cross\-team planning, delivery management, resource planning, and stakeholder alignment.
* Experience establishing engineering standards for accessibility, testing, observability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Ability to balance hands\-on technical judgment with people leadership and business priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Good to Have**


* Experience building or scaling a design system, shared component library, or frontend platform.
* Experience with micro\-frontends, modular frontend architectures, or large multi\-application frontend ecosystems.
* Experience with frontend performance monitoring, error tracking, analytics, and observability tools.
* Familiarity with cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging, and progressive delivery practices.
* Experience leading frontend modernization, migration, or platform adoption initiatives.
* Familiarity with frontend security practices, including authentication, authorization, secure data handling, and browser security considerations.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and quality.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================


30 Days


* Develop a clear understanding of the frontend organization, teams, technical landscape, delivery priorities, and key stakeholders.
* Build trusted partnerships across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and Security.
* Assess team health, leadership capability, talent needs, delivery risks, and frontend engineering maturity.

title: React Native Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 Role: React Native Developer Location: Hyderabad only Work Mode: Hybrid (3 days) 
 
 Role overview 
 We are seeking an experienced React Native Developer with 10+ years of mobile application development experience to design, develop and maintain high-quality cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in React Native, JavaScript/TypeScript, native mobile development, application security, architecture, performance optimization and the complete mobile application lifecycle. Experience with React Natives New Architecture, native modules and AI-native development practices is highly preferred. 
 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 1.Mobile Application Development 
 Design, develop and maintain high-quality mobile applications using React Native. Build and enhance applications for both iOS and Android platforms. Ensure applications are production-ready and aligned with business and technical requirements. Work with native modules and platform-specific capabilities using Kotlin/Java and/or Swift/Objective-C. Ensure successful application builds, releases and deployments to Google Play Store and Apple App Store. 
 
 2.React Native Native Platform Development 
 Develop applications using React Native, including the New Architecture with Fabric and TurboModules. Implement state management using Redux, Zustand, MobX or similar technologies. Work with navigation frameworks and REST/GraphQL integrations. Collaborate with native platform technologies including Jetpack Compose/MVVM and SwiftUI/UIKit. Design and implement reusable, scalable and maintainable components. 
 
 3.Security Data Privacy 
 Implement secure storage and encryption using technologies such as Keychain, Keystore, encrypted AsyncStorage and MMKV. Apply secure networking practices across mobile applications. Ensure compliance with applicable data privacy and security requirements. Identify and address mobile application security vulnerabilities. Follow security best practices and familiarity with OWASP MSTG guidelines. 
 
 4.AI-Native Development 
 Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for code generation, refactoring, debugging and testing. Effectively prompt AI agents for application scaffolding, integrations and development workflows. Review and validate AI-generated code before integration. Identify risks associated with AI-generated code, including insecure recommendations, hallucinated APIs and intellectual property concerns. Apply mandatory human review and engineering standards to AI-assisted development. 
 
 5.Architecture Design 
 Apply MVVM, Clean Architecture and common design patterns such as Factory, Adapter and Observer. Ensure consistent architectural practices across cross-platform and native code. Design scalable, maintainable and high-performing mobile application architectures. Contribute to technical decisions and architectural improvements. 
 
 6.CI/CD, Release Application Lifecycle 
 Work with Git and Azure DevOps for source control and development workflows. Implement and maintain mobile CI/CD pipelines. Work with tools such as Fastlane, App Center and Bitrise. Manage the complete mobile application lifecycle, including build, submission, deployment, monitoring and maintenance. Troubleshoot release and deployment issues across iOS and Android platforms. 
 
 7.Performance Quality 
 Perform mobile application performance profiling and optimization. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks. Ensure applications meet quality, stability and usability expectations. Collaborate with QA teams to support testing, debugging and release readiness. 
 
 8.UI/UX Cross-functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with UI/UX designers to deliver high-quality mobile experiences. Ensure designs are translated accurately into responsive and intuitive mobile interfaces. Collaborate effectively with product, engineering, QA and other cross-functional teams. Communicate technical decisions, challenges and progress clearly to stakeholders. 
 
 Required technical skills and competencies 
 10+ years of experience in React Native/mobile application development. Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript. description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 Cohesity is looking for a Front End Software Engineer to join one of our largest teams in Cloud Vertical. With millions of documents, terabytes of emails, and endless Teams conversations, we deal with unprecedented data volumes that require unique strategies and algorithms to process data efficiently. Keeping pace with the changing nature of products while ensuring seamless protection is a puzzle we solve every day. Our team tackles these challenges head\-on with creativity, technical expertise, and a passion for excellence. Through mentorship, cross\-training, and constant learning, you’ll grow your skills in ways you never imagined. Be part of a mission\-critical team to protect the data that drives businesses across the world.
   

  

 As a Front End Software Engineer, you will be an individual contributor focused on delivering features with high quality, along with continuous quality improvements with the help of automation. Working on the UI, you’ll be expected to coordinate with Product Management and User Experience team on the mock\-ups as well as with the backend engineers on the interfaces and end\-to\-end testing. There will be a large variety of features to work on including: distributed and parallel data flows, cloud services, asynchronous programming, performance optimization, infinite scalability, snapshots, resiliency, multiple protocols, and fault tolerance.
   

  

 We are a passionate team of customer obsessed and quality focused engineers with a desire to disrupt the way organizations manage and protect their data, to help them unleash the maximum value locked in their data. We are looking for an outstanding UI Engineer to expand our team of UI engineers that are excited about building quality products and delivering value to customers through simplifying the world of data management.
   

  

**How You’ll Spend Your Time Here**
 As part of this team, you will design and build massively distributed systems at web\-scale. You’ll be building the UI that is closest to the customers when they are interacting with Cohesity’s hyper\-converged, highly\-scalable storage clusters.
   

  

**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING**
* 2\+ years of developing and troubleshooting UI in large scale distributed systems
* BE/BTech degree in Computer Science with proficiency in data structures, algorithms, and software design. Master’s degree would be a plus.
* Strong understanding of UX and UI design principles
* Expertise in HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Strong knowledge of front\-end frameworks and libraries such as React, Angular

* Excellent analytical and multi\-tasking skills
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills
