title: React Developer
description:
**About The Role**
 Job Description: UI Developer (6\+ Years with Next.js 14\+, React 18\+, TypeScript, AWS ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, CI/CD, Terraform, REST / GraphQL, AWS Certified)
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Frontend Architecture \& Development
* Architect and develop modern web applications using Next.js 14\+ (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, Streaming SSR, Parallel Routes)
* Design reusable, accessible component libraries using React 18\+, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS / Radix UI
* Implement rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR, CSR) based on page\-level performance and SEO requirements
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints via Next.js Route Handlers and middleware
* Implement authentication flows (NextAuth.js, OAuth 2\.0, JWT, SAML) with session management
* Write comprehensive tests
* Data Layer \& PostgreSQL Integration
* Design data\-fetching patterns connecting Next.js to PostgreSQL via Prisma, Drizzle ORM, or raw SQL with connection pooling (PgBouncer, RDS Proxy)
* Build type\-safe database queries with proper error handling, pagination, and optimistic updates
* Implement caching strategies (React Cache, revalidation tags) to minimize database roundtrips
* Collaborate on schema design, indexing strategies, and query optimization for frontend\-driven data access
* AWS \& ECS Deployment
* Containerize Next.js applications using Docker with multi\-stage builds (standalone output mode)
* Deploy and manage apps on AWS ECS (Fargate/EC2\) with task definitions, service configs, and auto\-scaling
* Configure ALB with health checks, path\-based routing, and SSL/TLS termination via ACM
* Set up CI/CD pipelines (CodePipeline) for automated build, test, and deploy to ECS
* Manage infrastructure using IaC (Terraform)
* Integrate with AWS services: RDS PostgreSQL, S3 \+ CloudFront, ElastiCache, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, WAF, SQS/SNS
* Performance, Observability \& Security
* Implement frontend observability: structured logging, error tracking (Sentry, Datadog RUM), performance monitoring
* Configure CloudWatch Container Insights for ECS task\-level metrics
* Apply security best practices: CSP, CORS, input sanitization, XSS/CSRF protection, dependency scanning
* Ensure WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility compliance with automated testing (axe\-core, Lighthouse CI)
* Leadership \& Collaboration
* Lead frontend architecture decisions; document via ADRs
* Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge\-sharing sessions
* Translate Figma designs into pixel\-perfect, responsive implementations
* Stay current with Next.js releases, React ecosystem, and AWS service updates
* Required Qualifications
* 6\+ years professional frontend development; 3\+ years building production apps in Next.js
* Professional Certification (required) — one or more:
* AWS Certified Developer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
* Meta Front\-End Developer Professional Certificate
* Strong TypeScript proficiency — generics, discriminated unions, type guards, utility types, strict mode
* React expertise — hooks, context, suspense, concurrent features, server components, state management (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query)
* Hands\-on AWS ECS experience — task definitions, Fargate, ALB, auto\-scaling
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL — SQL queries, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, indexing, migrations, ORM (Prisma/Drizzle)
* Docker — production Dockerfiles, multi\-stage builds, Docker Compose
* Modern CSS: Tailwind CSS, CSS Grid, Flexbox, responsive design
* CI/CD pipelines for containerized frontend deployments
* Git workflows (trunk\-based or GitFlow), PR reviews, semantic versioning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS certifications (such as Developer \+ Solutions Architect)
* Experience with Next.js Middleware for edge routing, A/B testing, feature flags
* OpenTelemetry instrumentation for distributed tracing
* GraphQL (Apollo Client, urql) and schema\-first API development
* Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 and connection management in container contexts
* Micro\-frontend architectures (Module Federation, multi\-zone Next.js)
* Experience in regulated industries (Sox)
* Key Skills at a Glance
* Next.js 14\+, React 18\+, TypeScript, AWS ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, CI/CD, Terraform, REST / GraphQL, AWS Certified

title: Product Engineer Intern - Unibox
description:
ABOUT LIFIE AI
 



  





 Lifie AI helps businesses automate customer engagement across voice, chat, and outbound campaigns. Our AI agents help sales and operations teams respond to leads faster, run high\-volume outreach, qualify prospects, verify data, and improve conversion without increasing headcount.
 



  





 Backed by angel investors and experienced enterprise technology leaders, Lifie AI has crossed $120K in ARR and is continuing to grow. We are running pilots with NASDAQ\-listed enterprises and building vendor and technology partnerships with multiple enterprise platforms.
 



  





 We work with businesses across India, North America, and other global markets. We are now expanding our engineering team and looking for a fresher Product Engineer Intern who wants to build real product, ship fast, and learn directly from the founders.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 We are hiring a Product Engineer Intern to build and ship features across Unibox — our CRM/inbox/campaigns product — a real, live product surface used by paying customers.
 



  





 This is a hybrid internship based in HSR, Bengaluru — freshers and final\-year students welcome, no professional experience required.
 



  





 You will work across the entire stack — from React/TypeScript and TanStack Start on the frontend to Postgres and Cloudflare on the backend — while building integrations with AI, voice, telephony, payments, and other external services.
 



  





 You will work directly with the founders and engineering team, with real ownership of features from day one — not shadowing, not busywork.
 



  





 Strong performers get a full\-time offer at the end of the internship, with a revised salary and equity (see Compensation \& Growth below).
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 



  





 \- Build and ship features across the React/TypeScript frontend (TanStack Start) on Unibox
 



 \- Work with Postgres — schema design, queries, and secure data access patterns
 



 \- Build and debug backend logic in serverless/edge functions (Cloudflare Workers)
 



 \- Integrate third\-party APIs across voice/telephony (Twilio, Plivo), billing (Stripe), and AI (Anthropic, Groq \- quick inference models)
 



 \- Work across real CRM product domains — objects like companies, prospects, and deals; inbox and messaging; campaigns and outreach workflows
 



 \- Write clean, typed code that follows existing patterns, and ship it through code review
 



 \- Debug production issues directly alongside founders and engineers
 



 \- Develop a strong understanding of how Unibox is architected end\-to\-end
 



  





 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 \- Freshers and final\-year students (CS or related background) welcome — no professional experience required
 



 \- Solid fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and basic SQL/databases
 



 \- Comfortable reading and navigating an existing codebase, not just building from scratch
 



 \- Curious, coachable, and eager to learn how a real product is built and shipped
 



 \- Strong ownership instinct — willing to dig in, ship, and iterate quickly
 



 \- Personal projects, hackathons, open\-source contributions, or prior internships are a plus, but not mandatory
 



 \- Interest in AI, CRM, or SaaS products is a plus
 



 \- Able to work hybrid out of our HSR, Bengaluru office
 



  





 YOU'LL DO WELL IN THIS ROLE IF
 



  





 \- You take ownership instead of waiting for instructions
 



 \- You care about code quality, not just features shipped
 



 \- You debug systematically instead of guessing
 



 \- You continuously test and improve your approach
 



 \- You are comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment
 



 \- You want to grow into a full\-time, full\-stack engineering role
 



  





 COMPENSATION \& GROWTH
 



  





 \- Stipend: ₹15,000–₹30,000/month during the internship, based on interview performance and fit
 



 \- Performance\-based increase: exceptional performers can move up to ₹8 LPA CTC on conversion to a full\-time role — this is not automatic, it's earned through consistent, high\-quality shipped work during the internship
 



 \- Stock options (ESOP): on full\-time conversion, you become eligible for an ESOP grant from Lifie AI's employee option pool — standard 4\-year vesting with a 1\-year cliff, subject to board approval
 



 \- Path: Internship → performance review → full\-time Product Engineer offer with revised CTC \+ ESOP
 



  





 WHY JOIN LIFIE AI
 



  





 \- Join an angel\-backed AI startup with growing enterprise adoption
 



 \- Own real product surfaces on a live, paying\-customer product, not a side project
 



 \- Work directly with the founders and engineering team from day one
 



 \- Build and ship a CRM/AI product solving high\-value problems for global businesses
 



 \- Real path to a full\-time role with a strong CTC, ESOP, and growth into a senior full\-stack engineering role

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


### **The Team**


Public Cloud (Prisma) \- As the leader of the Public Cloud Security team, you willbe responsible for buildingproducts that protect data, workloads, and infrastructure forsome of the largest enterprise customers in the world.We help the customers in theirtransitional journeyto the cloud by ensuring they have the best\-in\-class protection. The cloud market hasbeen growing at a rapid rate forthe last few years. As moreand more enterprises use public cloud, there is an insatiable demand for securing workloads in the public cloud.With our recent acquisition of Prisma PublicCloud, formerly RedLock™,and Evident.io, Palo Alto Networks is the reigning market leader.  

  



### **Job Summary**


As a Staff Software Frontend Engineer on the Prisma AIRS Red Teaming team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI security. You will work on the architectural design and implementation of cutting\-edge frontend solutions, translating complex user needs into intuitive interfaces. Working closely with a diverse team of product managers, UX designers, and backend engineers, you will drive technical excellence and establish best practices to make a significant impact on a product that is redefining how organizations secure their AI systems.  

  



### **Key Responsibilities**


* Develop highly graphical and scalable web application features that offer customers insights into their red teaming engagements and provide actionable solution suggestions.
* Analyze complex red teaming problems, evaluate in\-depth requirements, and apply advanced engineering techniques to achieve high\-quality results.
* Proactively identify problems and opportunities, proposing and developing simple, attainable solutions to enhance team development processes and product quality.
* Lead collaborative discussions with product managers, UX designers, and backend engineers to ensure alignment and create synergy for product features.
* Serve as a role model by establishing and implementing engineering best practices, including test\-driven development, for red teaming solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning within the frontend team.
**Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience.
* Expertise in building web\-based GUIs with ReactJS, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+).
* Proven experience with modern web frameworks and build tools such as React, Hooks, Webpack, Vite, and Storybook.
* Experience with client\-side build tools and CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions or GitLab.
### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Familiarity with Micro Frontend architecture patterns.
* Experience with data visualization libraries and building complex dashboards.
* Experience with UI test frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, and react\-testing\-library.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes and experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with Secure by Design patterns and best security practices.
**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Take an enterprise prospect from first technical conversation to a live, adopted deployment: scoping what is genuinely buildable, building the demo, the custom agents, and the skills yourself, and being personally accountable for the first moment the customer's own team sees the product do something real.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Pre\-sale, technically. Sit in discovery, work out the minimal viable setup for this prospect, then build and run the demo yourself. You decide what is feasible; nothing enters a proposal without your scoping behind it, and your "no" blocks the line item.
* The demo and the setup, hands\-on. Configure the workspace, wire the data sources and connectors, seed the brand knowledge, and get the outputs looking like this customer's brand. Not a spec you hand to someone—an environment you stand up.
* Custom agents and skills, for the whole life of the account. Most enterprise requirements don't land as a feature request—they land as "our category model isn't yours," "this claim needs a compliance check we do differently," or "this report has to arrive in our format." You build the agents and skills that close that gap: writing them, wiring them to the customer's sources and connectors, testing the output quality, deploying them into their workspace, and maintaining them as the requirement moves. This runs from the pre\-sale demo through onboarding and continues once they're live—it is not a one\-time setup task.
* Onboarding through go\-live. Run the POC and the training with the customer's day\-to\-day users, not just the executive buyer. Gather custom requirements directly, and be honest about which are configuration and which need engineering—the second kind gets flagged as roadmap evidence and never committed to a date.
* The requirements trail. Enterprise onboardings run on daily standups where asks arrive informally, one at a time, for weeks. Keeping that legible—what was asked, by whom, what we agreed, what the customer still owes us—is a core part of the job, not admin around it.
* The wow moment, as a number. You own the success metric for the journey from pre\-sale to go\-live. It has to be measurable, falsifiable, and meaningful to the people using the product daily—a dashboard only the buyer ever opens is a failed deployment.
* Escalations inside your window. A blocked demo, a stalled data\-access request, a POC going quiet: yours. Post\-launch product issues route to Product; you stay involved only to settle what was actually promised.


**Your day\-to\-day toolkit**
 This is the seat's actual working surface—what an ordinary Tuesday looks like. We run AI\-native internally, not as a talking point: the expectation is that you drive these tools yourself rather than asking someone to run them for you.
   

  

 For What you'll live in Building agents, skills, and demo setups Claude Code and equivalent agentic dev tools—writing skills, wiring MCP connectors, scripting against our APIs, automating the repetitive parts of your own job Customer conversations Clarify—call recordings, transcripts, and notes; every discovery, demo, and standup is captured there and is the raw material for scoping. Product and engineering handoff Linear—issues, projects, milestones; where a requirement goes when it needs engineering rather than configuration Prototyping an idea before it costs engineering time A working prototype is often the fastest way to settle a scoping argument. Proving adoption PostHog—is the thing you deployed actually being used, by whom, how often Comms and documents Slack (internal, incl. canvases) and Google Workspace—SOWs, requirement trackers, training material, status writeups The knowledge base A maintained internal wiki of accounts, modules, objections, and past decisions—you're expected to read it before a call and add to it after.
   

  

 What "AI\-native" means concretely here. You should be someone who reaches for an agent before doing forty minutes of manual work: pulling a transcript apart into a requirements list, reconciling a customer's tracker against Linear, and turning a discovery call into a configuration plan. Much of the internal tooling around this seat is itself built as skills and scheduled agents—you will use them, and you will be expected to write new ones when you notice the same manual task twice.
   

  

**The stack you'll work in**
 We are not screening for an exact tool list—most of this is learnable in weeks by someone who has done the shape of the job before. What we do need is that you've worked at this altitude: built things against ad\-platform and analytics APIs, handled a client's data on their terms, and shipped LLM\-backed features you were responsible for the quality of. Read the lists below as "you should recognize most of a column and have real depth in some of it", not as requirements.
   

  

**Must\-haves**
* You have carried enterprise customers end to end—discovery through live usage—in a technical, customer\-facing seat (forward deployed engineer, solutions/implementation engineer, technical account, or delivery engineer). Not pure pre\-sale, not pure post\-sale.
* You build—including with LLMs. Comfortable in Python or an equivalent for real work: pulling and reshaping messy client data, calling APIs, wiring integrations, and standing up a demo environment without waiting on an engineering queue. On top of that, you can build an agent or a skill against a requirement and judge whether its output is actually good—prompting, grounding it in the customer's own sources, evaluating quality, and iterating when it's wrong. You will be asked to show something you built. See the stack section above for what we run—equivalents count, exact\-tool matches aren't required.
* Scoping discipline under commercial pressure. You can say "that isn't what this does" to a room that wants to hear yes and can tell configuration apart from engineering on the spot.
* You write things down clearly. Requirements, scope, escalation replies, and status. Half of this job is being the reason nobody has to reconstruct what was agreed upon six weeks ago.
* Enterprise sales\-cycle literacy—you have worked with security reviews, compliance sign\-offs, procurement, and customer\-side stakeholders who control data access, and you route around them without over\-promising.


**Nice\-to\-haves**
* Regulated\-industry deployments (BFSI, insurance, healthcare) and the compliance\-boundary instincts that come with them.
* Real depth in one of the customer\-side categories above — paid media APIs, attribution, or martech/CRM integration—rather than passing familiarity with all of them.
* Depth beyond the basics on agent tooling: multi\-step/tool\-using agents, retrieval design, and structured evaluation of model output rather than eyeballing it.
* Having been the first or only person in a role like this at an earlier\-stage company.

description:
**Urban Company · Engineering** 




**Software Development Engineer – II iOS \+ React Native** 




 Location: Gurugram · Experience: 2–5 years · Team: Consumer Apps
 



  





 Every booking, every live job, every partner earnings screen at Urban Company lands on a phone across a wide range of devices, in a wide range of network conditions, and it has to feel instant. We are looking for an iOS engineer to own how that feels.
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardised, and reliable service experience. To fulfil this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company with three key principles in mind:
 



  




* **Customer love:** 
 Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services.
* **Partner empowerment:** 
 Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood.
* **Technology first:** 
 Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry.



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




 We are looking for a mobile engineer who is strong in
 **iOS (Swift)** 
 and also hands\-on with
 **React Native** 
 . Most of our app experience is built with React Native on top of native foundations, so you will work on both sides — writing native iOS code where performance and platform features matter, and React Native code for shared product experiences.
 



 This role is
 **cross\-platform by design** 
 . If you are iOS\-heavy, you should be excited to work on React Native. If you are React Native\-heavy, you should be excited to go deep into native iOS. We are clear about this from day one.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build and ship user\-facing experiences across our apps — native iOS where performance and platform features matter, React Native for shared product surfaces.
* Work cross\-platform every day: native modules, the RN–native boundary, and the New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI).
* Own releases end to end — phased rollout, post\-release monitoring, and the call to halt or roll back when the numbers say so.
* Raise the technical bar — code review, architectural input, and mentoring engineers earlier in their careers than you.



  





**Technology Stack** 




**Mobile:** 
 Swift, React Native, TypeScript
 



**iOS:** 
 UIKit and SwiftUI, Swift Concurrency, SPM and CocoaPods, Instruments, Xcode
 



**React Native:** 
 The New Architecture — Fabric, TurboModules, JSI — and Hermes
 



**Release \& Observability:** 
 CI/CD and Fastlane\-class automation, phased rollouts, crash and ANR monitoring, over\-the\-air updates
 



**Adjacent Exposure:** 
 Node.js and TypeScript services, micro\-frontends
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* **People who passed out in 2023 or after:** 
 Building mobile applications, with iOS as your primary platform.
* Strong hands\-on skills in
 **iOS (Swift / UIKit / SwiftUI)** 
 and
 **React Native** 
 — comfortable in both, with depth in at least one.
* You have thought seriously about
 **app performance** 
 and can explain what you measured, what you improved, and how.
* You have debugged
 **production issues on apps at large scale** 
 and can walk through your approach step by step.
* You know which
 **metrics to check after a big release** 
 to make sure the delivery is clean and bug\-free.
* You follow what is new
 **iOS 26 and upcoming platform changes** 
 , or React Native's
 **New Architecture** 
 : what it changes, its benefits, and how you have used or explored it.
* Comfort with React Native and TypeScript, or a real appetite to become good at it quickly.
* You are familiar with Appstore
* Strong ownership. You drive problems end to end rather than handing them across a boundary.



  





**Before You Apply — The Honest Bit** 




**Cross\-platform is the job** 




 This role sits on the iOS and React Native boundary, and you will work on both sides of it. iOS is where we want your depth. React Native and TypeScript will be part of your daily work — not an occasional favour. If you are looking to stay purely native, this is not the right role for you, and we would rather you knew that now.
 



  





**What Can You Expect at Urban Company** 



* Ownership of a platform used by every mobile engineer in the company and felt by every user on it.
* Performance and native problems at real scale, across multiple countries and a wide device spectrum.
* A high\-velocity engineering culture with quick iterations and real\-world feedback loops.
* Architectural influence earlier than most companies would give it.
* The chance to grow into senior technical leadership.

* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant\-to\-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Self\-starter with a strong drive to learn and adopt new technologies
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
* Good presentation and client\-facing skills
* Ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams

66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

**Overview of Role**
--------------------



66degrees Software Engineers within the Innovation team are catalysts for future growth. You will leverage your strong development foundation to explore emerging technologies, identify new opportunities, and rapidly prototype high\-impact "accelerators" and minimum viable products (MVPs) for our clients. Partnering with cross\-functional experts in AI, data, and cloud engineering, you will move beyond mission\-critical application delivery to actively shape the next generation of intelligent enterprise solutions. This role is for a highly motivated and exploratory individual passionate about turning complex challenges into clear, quantifiable outcomes and driving new value for the business.


### **Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain **end\-to\-end full stack applications**, combining scalable backend systems with intuitive frontend interfaces.
* Build and manage **data\-heavy backend systems**, with a strong focus on **data engineering, data warehousing, and data modeling**.
* Develop and maintain **ETL/ELT pipelines using Python** to ingest and process data from structured and unstructured sources into cloud data platforms.
* Create **responsive and high\-performance user interfaces using React.js**, enabling rich data visualizations and seamless user interactions.
* Work with **Big Data technologies and cloud data warehouses** (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) to ensure efficient data processing at scale.
* Leverage **cloud platforms (GCP)** and services like **Cloud Run, Cloud Functions**, or equivalent to build and deploy scalable microservices.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (AI, Data, Cloud, Product) to **translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions**.
* Implement **CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (TDD), and best engineering practices** to ensure high\-quality and reliable software delivery.
* Experiment with and implement **AI/ML and Generative AI use cases**, contributing to rapid prototyping of MVPs and accelerators.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and contribute to **innovation\-driven product development** within the organization.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* **3–8 years of experience** in full stack development with strong expertise in **Python (backend) and React.js (frontend)**.
* Hands\-on experience in **Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, and processing large\-scale datasets** (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake).
* Strong understanding of **ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and data architecture principles**.
* Experience working with **cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS/Azure acceptable)** and deploying scalable applications.
* Familiarity with **Big Data ecosystems and distributed data processing frameworks** is a plus.
* Working knowledge of **REST APIs, microservices architecture, and backend system design**.
* Proficiency with **Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Exposure to or strong interest in **AI/ML and Generative AI technologies** (LLMs, prompt engineering, etc.) is highly desirable.
* Strong **problem\-solving skills and analytical thinking**, with the ability to work on ambiguous and evolving requirements.
* Excellent **communication and collaboration skills**, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
* Demonstrated **learning mindset, adaptability, and curiosity**, with exposure to diverse technologies or domains being a plus.


We value candidates who demonstrate a balance of **technical depth (data/backend)** and **breadth (frontend, AI, product thinking)**, along with a strong attitude and willingness to learn.

 ***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

title: Software Development Intern, Operations Management Platform
description:
Job Summary This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action s technical partner in India. This is a 6 month, full time paid internship. India Safe Water Program is building a lightweight, purpose-built operations management platform to coordinate field and Head Quarter activity - similar in spirit to tools like Zoho or a lightweight CRM, but tailored to our programs workflows. The platform will be used to plan and track field visits, route approvals, manage vendor coordination, and give Head Quarter real-time visibility into activity status across the program. You will report to the Senior Officer, Safe Water Operations and work directly with the Data, Survey Operations team to design, build, and deploy this application from the ground up. You will get hands-on ownership of a real production system used daily by program staff - not a simulated project. This is a strong opportunity for someone early in their development career to build full-stack and DevOps experience in a live operational environment. What You Will Build The platform will support the following core modules: Field activity planning - scheduling and logging of field visits Approval workflows - multi-stage sign-off on planned and completed activities Activity tracker - status views for pending, in-process, and completed items Role-based administration - adding/removing users, assigning and revoking roles and permissions Secure user login and authentication Vendor coordination section - vendor-facing activity and status updates Head Quarter dashboard - consolidated view of activity across all field locations Follow-up and completion tracking, with basic notifications/reminders Responsibilities Build responsive front-end interfaces using HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript (React or another framework, as agreed with the team). Develop REST APIs using Node.js and Express, with clean, well-documented JSON contracts. Design and manage relational data models in MySQL or PostgreSQL. Implement authentication and role-based authorization for different user types (Head Quarter, field, vendor, admin). Build activity dashboards and status visualizations using Chart.js and Bootstrap. Deploy and maintain the application on AWS (EC2, IAM, Security Groups, S3). Configure and manage the production server using Linux fundamentals - SSH, file permissions, and process management. Set up Nginx as a reverse proxy with HTTPS, and manage the app process using PM2. Use Git and GitHub for version control, with clean commit practices and basic code review. Support basic logging and monitoring so issues in production can be identified and traced. Document setup, deployment, and handover steps so the application can be maintained after the internship ends. Essential Completed a degree in Computer Science IT, or a related field (or equivalent self-taught/bootcamp experience) Project experience on the following platforms HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript Bootstrap and Chart.js REST API design and JSON Node.js and Express MySQL or PostgreSQL Git and GitHub Linux administration/MAC (SSH, file permissions, processes) Desirable Working knowledge of AWS - EC2, IAM, Security Groups, and S3 Experience with Nginx, HTTPS/SSL configuration, and PM2 Familiarity with React or another modern front-end framework Understanding of authentication/authorization patterns (JWT, sessions, role-based access control) Awareness of basic performance optimization and application logging/monitoring practices A prior academic, freelance, or personal project involving a deployed full-stack application Position Location New Delhi, India.
